房颤与消融（14）

  • Electrophysiology Team-Administered Conscious Sedation for Pulsed-Field Versus Radiofrequency Ablation in Atrial Fibrillation.
    Anesthesiol Res Pract · 2026-10-30
    在低危房颤患者中，电生理团队实施的清醒镇静用于脉冲场消融可行，耐受性和安全性可接受，且不延长手术时间。
  • Potassium and Cardiovascular Disease.
    Cardiol Rev · 2026-10-30
    本综述指出低钾血症（<3.5 mEq/L）在住院患者中发生率可达20%，可增加室性与房性心律失常风险，而高钾血症（>5.5 mEq/L）常见于肾衰竭及心肾疾病用药，两者均需规范管理。
  • Tumour-anchored Purkinje-mediated ventricular tachycardia in a child with cardiac rhabdomyoma.
    Cardiol Young · 2026-10-30
    10岁结节性硬化症男孩的残余心脏横纹肌瘤邻近区域存在维拉帕米敏感性分支型室速，电生理标测证实为浦肯野纤维介导的折返，肿瘤旁消融成功消除心律失常。
  • Echocardiographic markers for left atrial stiffness and left atrial conduction delay in patients with silent paroxysmal atrial fibrillation compared to age-matched controls.
    Cardiovasc Ultrasound · 2026-10-30
    在老年无症状阵发性房颤患者中，左房僵硬指数（LASI）和左房激活时间（LA-AT）显著升高，且独立于左房容积，提示可无创检测早期心房重构。
  • Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Pharmacodynamics of SHR-2004, a Novel Humanized Monoclonal Antibody Targeting Factor XI, in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: An Open-Label Phase 1b Study.
    Clin Pharmacokinet · 2026-10-30
    在10例房颤患者中，每2周皮下注射180mg SHR-2004耐受性良好，无大出血事件，FXI活性中位数降至1.40%，aPTT延长，药效学达稳态。
  • Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease/Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease and the Risk of Incident Atrial Fibrillation: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Cohort Studies.
    Cureus · 2026-10-30
    纳入18项队列、逾1500万人的荟萃分析显示，NAFLD/MASLD患者发生房颤的风险较无该病者升高约23%（RR 1.23，95%CI 1.12-1.34）。
  • Atrial Fibrillation in Tribal and Non-tribal Populations: A Comparative Analysis From Eastern India.
    Cureus · 2026-10-30
    印度东部部落房颤患者首诊房颤比例更高、心室率更快、左室射血分数更低且生活方式危险因素更多，而非部落患者心代谢紊乱和血栓栓塞风险更高。
  • Obesity and Atrial Fibrillation: Integrating Lifestyle, Pharmacotherapy and Ablation.
    Europace · 2026-10-30
  • Suspected atrioesophageal fistula complicated by coronary air embolism after catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: direct angiographic visualization and catheter aspiration in a case report.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-30
    84岁女性房颤射频消融联合左心耳封堵术后1个月，突发意识丧失、发热和ST段抬高，冠脉造影直接显示右冠状动脉气体并抽吸，疑似房食管瘘并发冠脉空气栓塞，27小时内死亡。
  • Plasma magnesium levels and postoperative atrial fibrillation after cardiac surgery: a cohort study.
    Interdiscip Cardiovasc Thorac Surg · 2026-10-30
    在积极补镁方案下，心脏术后血浆镁浓度（正常至偏高范围）与术后房颤无独立关联，术后房颤主要与年龄、手术类型及严重左室功能不全相关。
  • Remimazolam for Procedural Sedation During Synchronized Electrical Cardioversion in the Emergency Department.
    J Am Coll Emerg Physicians Open · 2026-10-30
    67岁阵发性房颤快速心室率患者，急诊同步电复律前单次静注瑞马唑仑5 mg，49秒起效、4分30秒完全恢复定向力，无呼吸循环不良事件，200 J单次电击复律成功。
  • Outcomes of Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement in the Middle East and North Africa: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-30
    中东和北非地区48项研究、7331例TAVR患者汇总显示器械成功率达96.4%，永久起搏器植入是最常见并发症（10.0/100人年）。
  • Efficacy of Stellate Ganglion Block for Preventing Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Cardiac Surgery: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-30
    术前超声引导右侧星状神经节阻滞未能降低瓣膜术后7天内房颤发生率（43% vs 40%），但可减少术中室颤/室速需除颤、减轻心肌损伤并降低术后急性肾损伤风险。
  • Fluoroscopy-Free Esophageal Temperature Probe Positioning During Hybrid Atrial Fibrillation Ablation.
    J Cardiothorac Vasc Anesth · 2026-10-29

室性心律失常（8）

  • Effectiveness of Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator Therapy for Primary Prevention in Patients with Nonischemic Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction.
    Arq Bras Cardiol · 2026-10-30
    在非缺血性HFrEF患者中，ICD一级预防可显著降低心源性猝死和心血管死亡，但主要分析未显著降低全因死亡。
  • Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists and the risk of ventricular arrhythmia in patients with acute myocardial infarction and type 2 diabetes mellitus: a propensity score-matched cohort study.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-10-30
    在合并2型糖尿病的急性心肌梗死患者中，GLP-1受体激动剂治疗与室性心律失常风险降低相关（校正HR 0.61），但多项敏感性分析未达统计学显著性，结论需谨慎解读。
  • Complex arrhythmias in the absence of severe valvulitis: a paediatric case of acute rheumatic fever.
    Cardiol Young · 2026-10-30
    一例15岁男孩急性风湿热患者，在无严重瓣膜炎情况下出现复杂室性心律失常，包括非持续性室性心动过速。
  • Sudden Cardiac Death in Firefighters From the United States: A 16-Year Postmortem Analysis.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-30
    美国消防员执勤期间心脏性猝死中，81.8%由冠状动脉疾病/缺血性心脏病或高血压性心脏病所致，提示早期筛查和危险因素干预可能预防多数事件。
  • Low-Intensity Focused Ultrasound Modulation of Stellate Ganglion Attenuates Post-STEMI Ventricular Arrhythmias: First-in-Human Feasibility Study.
    JACC Asia · 2026-10-30
    首个人体可行性研究显示，低强度聚焦超声调控左侧星状神经节可降低STEMI直接PCI后72小时室性心律失常负荷，并改善心率变异性，安全性良好。
  • Electrical Storm in Advanced Chagas Cardiomyopathy Treated With Stereotactic Arrhythmia Radiotherapy After LVAD Implantation.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-30
    一例晚期恰加斯心肌病合并电风暴患者，在LVAD植入后仍反复室速，经多模态引导的立体定向心律失常放疗（STAR）后随访期内未再发生持续性室速或ICD放电。
  • Cat eye syndrome chromosome region, candidate 1 is a novel prognostic biomarker in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
    Mol Biomed · 2026-10-30
    在肥厚型心肌病中，心肌和血浆CECR1水平降低与心血管死亡和心脏性猝死风险升高独立相关，将其加入HCM Risk-SCD模型可显著提升风险分层的预测效能。
  • Vagal maneuvers and pharmacological cardioversion in stable PSVT: A systematic review with implications for emergency nursing practice.
    iScience · 2026-10-30
    改良Valsalva动作在稳定PSVT成人中较标准Valsalva及颈动脉窦按摩转复率更高且安全，腺苷有效但复发和不适更多，支持其作为药物升级前一线选择。

器械治疗（2）

  • Transjugular implantation of a leadless pacemaker in a 97-year-old patient with severe kyphosis and tortuous femoral veins: a case report.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-30
    97岁严重后凸畸形伴股静脉迂曲的高级别房室传导阻滞患者，经右颈内静脉成功植入无导线起搏器，围术期无并发症，随访设备参数稳定。
  • Atrial Leadless Pacing: A Potential Strategy for Cardioinhibitory Vasovagal Syncope.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-29
    本文为综述性文章，探讨心房无导线起搏作为心脏抑制型血管迷走性晕厥潜在治疗策略的可行性，但摘要未报告任何原始研究数据。

遗传与基础（1）

  • Advances and challenges in personalized cardiac modeling and simulation for predicting the risk of sudden death from malignant arrhythmias in post-myocardial infarction.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-30
    针对心肌梗死后恶性室性心律失常风险，基于LGE-CMR的个体化多尺度心脏建模与仿真可无创定量评估致心律失常易感性，有望弥补LVEF单一指标在ICD预防决策中的不足。

item.title: 2026-10-30 心脏电生理日报（29 篇）
item.description:
共 29 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（15）

  • Stroke-Heart Syndrome: Mechanisms, Temporal Phenotypes, and Diagnostic Reasoning.
    Adv Sci (Weinh) · 2026-10-29
    卒中-心脏综合征是急性卒中后30天内出现或加重的心脏异常，机制涉及中枢自主网络破坏等多因素，诊断需结合时间线和系列检查，目前无特异性治疗。
  • Deep learning analysis of sinus-rhythm echocardiography for the identification of patients with atrial fibrillation.
    Eur Heart J Digit Health · 2026-10-29
    在窦性心律经胸超声心动图上应用深度学习模型可区分有无房颤病史（AUC 0.85），且模型阳性者后续房颤记录及不良复合终点风险显著升高。
  • Malignant Ventricular Arrhythmias following Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A systematic review of published cases and mechanistic insights.
    Europace · 2026-10-29
  • Impact of obesity on clinical outcomes and the treatment effect of catheter ablation in atrial fibrillation: insights from CABANA.
    Europace · 2026-10-29
    CABANA事后分析显示，肥胖不影响导管消融相对药物治疗的疗效，但II度及以上肥胖患者绝对预后更差。
  • Impact of obesity on procedural safety and 1-year outcomes after pulsed-field ablation for atrial fibrillation.
    Europace · 2026-10-29
    在FRANCE-PFA全国注册研究中，高BMI与更晚期房颤表型和更广泛消融策略相关，但并非围术期并发症或1年心律失常复发的独立预测因素。
  • The weight of evidence: does obesity really not matter for atrial fibrillation ablation? Lessons from CABANA.
    Europace · 2026-10-29
  • Optimization of direct oral anticoagulant prescribing in primary care: a pharmacotherapeutic review in real-world clinical practice and therapeutic efficiency.
    Front Pharmacol · 2026-10-29
    在西班牙初级保健中，药师主导的多学科干预使66.6%的DOAC患者被建议优化治疗（阿哌沙班换为达比加群），2025年估计节省10.7万欧元，出血率保持稳定（5.3% vs 5.2%）。
  • Environmental assessment of hemophilia therapies. Comment on: "Carbon footprint of direct oral anticoagulants in atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolism".
    Haematologica · 2026-10-29
    该文为针对直接口服抗凝药碳足迹研究的评论，无原始摘要数据，无法提取研究对象、样本量与终点结果。
  • CHAMPION-AF and left atrial appendage closure: non-inferiority or a trade-off in risk?
    Indian J Thorac Cardiovasc Surg · 2026-10-29
    CHAMPION-AF 试验显示，在适合长期抗凝的非瓣膜性房颤患者中，Watchman FLX 左心耳封堵在心血管死亡、卒中或系统性栓塞复合终点上不劣于 NOAC，并减少非手术相关出血，但缺血性卒中数值上增多，整体体现风险谱的转换而非治疗等效。
  • The Rising Burden of Atrial Fibrillation and Respiratory Failure Mortality in the United States: A 25-Year Nationwide Retrospective Analysis of Death Certificate Data.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-29
    美国55岁以上成人中，死亡证明同时记录房颤和呼吸衰竭的年龄调整死亡率在25年间增长约5倍，从7.84升至41.76/10万，且独立于COVID-19和心衰记录。
  • Posterior Pulmonary Vein Isolation Lesion Spacing and Left Atrial Posterior Wall Narrowing During Pulsed Field Ablation.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-29
    在脉冲场消融中，基于所有消融标记间距（ITD）引导的工作流程可保留更宽的左房后壁残余带宽，减少后壁变窄。
  • Transient Lung-Volume Reduction Improves First-Shock Cardioversion Success by Reducing Transthoracic Impedance in Patients With Persistent Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-29
    在持续性房颤患者中，直流电复律前实施标准化短暂肺容积减少操作可显著降低经胸阻抗，使首次200 J电击复律成功率从29.3%提升至53.4%。
  • ERRATUM: Early real-life experience with a 3D-navigated pentaspline pulsed field catheter for ablation of atrial fibrillation - data from a Polish multicenter registry.
    Kardiol Pol · 2026-10-29
  • Do Loop Diuretics Cause Atrial Fibrillation in CKD?
    Kidney360 · 2026-10-29
  • Changes in circulating biomarkers in symptomatic atrial fibrillation from before to one day after catheter ablation
    Scientific Reports · 2026-10-29
    房颤患者与对照者存在12种循环生物标志物差异，导管消融术后第一天51种标志物显著变化，提示急性心肌损伤和炎症反应，但生物标志物与症状负担无关。

室性心律失常（6）

  • Can the QTc interval and T-wave morphology change intermittently in arrhythmogenic mitral valve prolapse? First paediatric case experience.
    Cardiol Young · 2026-10-29
    16岁女孩运动时心脏骤停，确诊致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂综合征，心电图示间歇性QTc延长且总伴下侧壁T波倒置，基因检测发现KCNH2和ANK2变异。
  • Deep-neural-network-assisted wavefront detection for the elimination of spiral-wave turbulence in cardiac-tissue models.
    Chaos · 2026-10-29
    在Aliev-Panfilov和TP06心脏组织模型中，螺旋波湍流的相关长度ξ越小越易被控制电流消除；基于U-Net预测钠电流线并施加自动调整幅值的电流可高效消除螺旋波。
  • Developing a case management program and clinical practice for high-risk sudden cardiac death patients through the lens of family systems theory.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-29
    基于家庭系统理论的个案管理方案可改善SCD高危患者的疾病认知、焦虑抑郁、运动恐惧及家庭关怀，并降低MACE。
  • GCTRNet: global context-gated temporal refinement for short-window ECG-based premature ventricular contraction detection.
    Front Physiol · 2026-10-29
    GCTRNet在短窗心电图上检测室性早搏，MIT-BIH数据库准确率99.65%、敏感度96.82%，跨库CPSC2021子集准确率97.83%、敏感度84.75%。
  • Validation of a Four-Extrastimulus Ventricular Stimulation Protocol for Arrhythmic Risk Stratification in Tetralogy of Fallot.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-29
    在修复后法洛四联症成人中，四额外刺激PVS方案可诱发SVA者占44%，随访期间仅诱发者发生SVA，阴性预测价值高。
  • Predicting in-silico ventricular tachycardia induction on fuzzy cardiac digital twins.
    Med Biol Eng Comput · 2026-10-29
    基于模糊心脏数字孪生的起搏结局预测器在10例法洛四联症修复术后患者中完全区分了临床可诱导与不可诱导VT的患者（10/10）。

器械治疗（4）

  • Coronary stent fixation of left ventricular lead during CRT-D implantation: a case series of three patients.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-29
    对3例CRT-D植入中因冠状静脉解剖不佳导致左室导线脱位的患者，采用西罗莫司洗脱支架固定导线，技术可行且短期参数稳定，但LVEF无改善。
  • Dissociation between structural reverse remodeling and clinical outcomes in ischemic cardiomyopathy undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy: a real-world analysis.
    Monaldi Arch Chest Dis · 2026-10-29
    在真实世界人群中，缺血性心肌病患者接受CRT后左室逆重构程度低于非缺血性心肌病，但全因死亡与心衰住院复合终点及总体生存率无显著差异。
  • Concomitant Aveir AR and Micra AV2 Hybrid Leadless Implantation During Infected Pacemaker Extraction.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-28
    在感染起搏器拔除术中，联合植入Aveir AR与Micra AV2无导线起搏器，实现心房起搏伴心室备份，同时保留心房设备电池寿命。
  • Feasibility of Left Bundle Branch Pacing and Management of Jailed Leads After Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Implantation.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-28
    经导管三尖瓣植入术后新发房室传导阻滞患者行左束支起搏可行，随访期间起搏参数与瓣膜功能稳定。

影像与标测（1）

  • Omnipolar Technology Near Field Versus Fragmentation Signals Mapping at Anatomically Defined Ganglionated Plexi Sites During Cardioneuroablation.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-29
    解剖引导的无影像心脏神经消融安全有效，急性成功率84.6%，随访81%无晕厥；OTNF与碎裂电位标测在GP位点一致性仅57.7%-65.4%，提示两者捕获部分不重叠的电生理信息。

遗传与基础（1）

  • Whole-Exome Sequencing Identifies a Rare CSRP3 Variant Associated With Familial Brugada Syndrome in a Lebanese Family.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-29
    在一黎巴嫩近亲婚配家系的三名Brugada综合征兄弟中，全外显子测序发现共有的罕见纯合CSRP3错义变异p.His19Arg，提示结构心肌基因可能参与BrS易感。

其他（2）

  • Sequential Associations of Sleep Architecture, Nocturnal Oxygenation, and Respiratory Disturbance With a Composite PSG-Derived Rhythm-Event Index.
    Brain Behav · 2026-10-29
    在41例睡眠中心患者中，仅较高的睡眠效率与较低的复合PSG节律事件指数独立相关，而AHI等呼吸事件指标无独立关联。
  • Insertable Cardiac Monitoring in Pediatric Patients: A Real-World Single-Center Experience With a New-Generation Device.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-28
    新一代LUX-Dx植入式心脏监测器在儿童患者中安全可行，诊断率达79%，远程程控可优化感知并减少警报负担。

item.title: 2026-10-29 心脏电生理日报（22 篇）
item.description:
共 22 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（13）

  • Cardiac Electrophysiological Impact of Sodium Glucose Cotransporter 2 Inhibitors: A Comprehensive Review.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-10-28
    SGLT2i可改善心脏自主神经平衡、减少房颤/房扑及部分队列中的心源性猝死，并可能通过调控miR-21、miR-29等microRNA减轻致心律失常基质。
  • Multimodality Imaging for Left Atrial Appendage Closure: Practical Guidance Across Preprocedural, Intraprocedural, and Postprocedural Phases.
    Circ Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-10-28
    本综述提出左心耳封堵术围术期多模态影像学的分阶段实践框架，强调标准化影像协议和器械特异性考量可提高手术安全性和长期预后。
  • Retraction: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Clinical Effectiveness of Intravenous Magnesium Sulphate in the Treatment of Acute Fast Atrial Fibrillation in Non-surgical Adult Patients.
    Cureus · 2026-10-28
    该摘要仅为撤稿声明，宣布撤回一篇关于静脉硫酸镁治疗非手术成人急性快速房颤疗效的系统评价与荟萃分析，未提供任何原始研究数据。
  • Renal Function and 4-Year Outcomes in Edoxaban-Treated Patients: A Sub-Analysis From the ETNA-AF Europe Study.
    Eur J Clin Invest · 2026-10-28
    在ETNA-AF-Europe研究中，接受标签推荐剂量艾多沙班的房颤患者中，较高CKD分期与卒中及心血管死亡风险增加相关，但调整混杂因素后出血和有效性结局无显著差异。
  • Factors associated with short- and long-term maintenance of sinus rhythm after successful elective electrical cardioversion.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-28
    择期电复律成功转复持续性房颤/房扑后，1个月窦律维持率89.7%，1年降至40.3%；早期复律、较小左房、低CHA2DS2-VASc评分、非吸烟、无既往电复律及抗心律失常药物治疗与窦律维持相关。
  • Massive Mediastinal Hematoma After Reablation for Atrial Fibrillation.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-28
    70岁女性，有心脏手术史和地中海贫血，房颤再消融后30小时发生巨大纵隔血肿（69.2×51.1 mm）压迫左心房，保守治疗2天症状改善，12个月随访完全吸收。
  • Anatomical Insight Into Idiopathic Ventricular Arrhythmias Originating From the Papillary Muscles.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-28
    本文综述乳头肌起源特发性室性心律失常的独特解剖与电生理特征，以优化导管消融策略。
  • Pilot safety and efficacy trial of amiodarone-infused biologic acellular biatrial patches to prevent new-onset postoperative atrial fibrillation.
    JTCVS Open · 2026-10-28
    在40例心脏术后患者中，胺碘酮浸润的双心房生物无细胞补片安全，且术后房颤发生率有临床意义的降低（20% vs 40%），但差异未达统计学显著。
  • Minimally invasive mitral surgery in patients with high pulmonary artery pressure: Results of a multicenter observational study.
    JTCVS Open · 2026-10-28
    在高肺动脉压患者中，微创二尖瓣手术的院内死亡率与低肺动脉压者相当，尽管高危患者并发症更多，但总体可接受。
  • Pericardial fluid cardiac troponin I predicts postoperative atrial fibrillation after coronary artery bypass grafting.
    JTCVS Open · 2026-10-28
    在接受择期冠状动脉旁路移植术的114例患者中，术后6小时心包引流液cTnI是术后房颤的独立预测因子，基于其构建的CALT评分预测效能优于现有评分工具。
  • Coronary sinus lactate at reperfusion: A predictor of atrial fibrillation after coronary artery bypass grafting.
    JTCVS Open · 2026-10-28
    在94例接受单纯CABG的患者中，再灌注后冠状窦乳酸>3 mmol/L与术后房颤风险增加11.7倍独立相关，提示该指标可用于指导预防。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion Versus Oral Anticoagulation in Atrial Fibrillation: A Comprehensive Evidence Synthesis.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-28
    在房颤患者中，左心耳封堵与口服抗凝相比缺血性卒中及大出血风险相当，但出血性卒中风险显著降低，重建IPD分析提示可能降低全因死亡。
  • Temporary Active Fixation Leads in Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement Patients With Baseline Right Bundle Branch Block.
    Struct Heart · 2026-10-28
    在合并基线右束支传导阻滞的TAVR患者中，主动固定螺旋电极临时起搏较传统电极显著降低ICU使用率并缩短住院时间，且不增加并发症。

室性心律失常（4）

  • The role of vascular resistance on coronary perfusion: differences between healthy and anomalous coronary origin under rest and exercise conditions.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-28
    在体外模型中，降低远端冠脉阻力可增加血流但轻度降低平均主动脉压，而降低主动脉压会减少冠脉血流，运动时压力-血流依赖性更强，该机制在左冠异常起源模型中可能增加血流动力学脆弱性。
  • Ventricular False Tendons and Ventricular Arrhythmias: Distinguishing Incidental Findings From Culprit Substrates.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-28
    心室假腱索常为良性 incidental 发现，仅少数可能作为室性心律失常的致病基质，需综合解剖、电生理、影像和操作证据分级判定。
  • Outcomes of Subcutaneous Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators in Patients Being Considered for Heart Transplantation: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-28
    在33例拟行心脏移植的终末期心衰患者中，S-ICD可提供有效心律失常保护，4例接受恰当放电，移植后无导线残留，但3例因P/T波过感知或快速房性心律失常发生不恰当放电。
  • Long-term variability of the blood pressure components and risk of mortality events and sudden cardiac death: a prospective cohort study (2002-2020).
    Nutr Metab Cardiovasc Dis · 2026-10-27
    在一般人群中，收缩压和舒张压的长期变异性独立于平均血压水平，与全因死亡和心血管死亡风险升高相关，且舒张压变异性与心脏性猝死风险增加相关。

器械治疗（2）

  • Anxiety and depressive symptoms decline during 12-month follow-up after cardiac resynchronization therapy implantation.
    Eur J Cardiovasc Nurs · 2026-10-28
  • Cardiac Arrest After Deceased Donor Kidney Transplant.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-28
    一例54岁终末期肾病女性在 deceased donor 肾移植后出现显著QT延长和反复尖端扭转型室速导致心脏骤停，经静脉镁和起搏器程控为100次/分后电稳定。

影像与标测（1）

  • Severe Atrial Compression Detected During Electroanatomical Mapping.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-28

遗传与基础（1）

  • Sudden Cardiac Death as the First Manifestation of Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy in a Young Female Athlete: Postmortem Morphologic Diagnosis.
    Cureus · 2026-10-28
    一例29岁女性网球运动员无既往心血管症状，猝死后尸检组织病理学符合致心律失常性右心室心肌病（ARVC），提示系统尸检对年轻运动员不明原因猝死的诊断价值。

其他（1）

  • Revisiting the Ischemic Cascade Using the Lens of Generative Artificial Intelligence.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-28

item.title: 2026-10-28 心脏电生理日报（38 篇）
item.description:
共 38 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（23）

  • Effects of RhBNP combined with immune modulation on immune function and short-term clinical outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation and heart failure.
    Am Heart J Plus · 2026-10-27
    在40例心衰合并永久性房颤患者中，常规治疗联合rhBNP及免疫调节中药7天可显著改善LVEF、降低BNP并提升CD3+、CD4+ T细胞计数及CD4+/CD8+比值。
  • Machine Learning-Based Classification of Right and Left Ventricular Outflow Tract Premature Ventricular Contractions.
    Ann Noninvasive Electrocardiol · 2026-10-27
    在43例经三维电解剖标测确认起源并成功消融的特发性流出道室早患者中，基于12导联心电图特征与年龄、性别的逻辑回归机器学习模型区分RVOT与LVOT起源的ROC-AUC达0.910。
  • Phenotyping of Arrhythmia-induced Cardiomyopathy: From Bench to Bedside and Back.
    Curr Heart Fail Rep · 2026-10-27
    心律失常性心肌病（AIC）是异质性谱系，房颤合并心衰患者导管消融节律控制优于药物治疗，表型分型有助于预测恢复和指导个体化治疗。
  • Don't Wait- Ablate! Catheter Ablation in Patients with Advanced Heart Failure and Atrial Fibrillation.
    Curr Heart Fail Rep · 2026-10-27
    对于合并晚期心衰的房颤患者，导管消融可显著降低死亡、紧急心脏移植或LVAD植入需求，应尽早转诊消融而非延迟。
  • Direct Oral Anticoagulants in the Cardiorenal Patient: Pharmacology, Kidney Function Estimation and Dose Selection Across the CKD Spectrum.
    Curr Issues Mol Biol · 2026-10-27
    综述指出房颤合并CKD患者的DOAC治疗需兼顾肾脏清除差异与肾功能估算方法不一致，VKA加速GFR下降，而CG与CKD-EPI公式差异导致4-34%患者剂量不一致。
  • Cost-effectiveness of pulsed field ablation of atrial fibrillation: a primer.
    Curr Opin Cardiol · 2026-10-27
    综述指出脉冲场消融治疗房颤可能具有成本效益，但现有证据有限且随访仅1年，需更多长期研究确认。
  • Association Between Admission Calculated Serum Osmolality and New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Non-ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction Undergoing Percutaneous Coronary Intervention.
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-10-27
    在行PCI的NSTEMI患者中，入院计算血清渗透压升高与新发房颤独立相关（每10 mOsm/kg调整OR 1.565），但增量预测价值有限。
  • Acute gastric dilatation and portal venous gas after pulsed field ablation for atrial fibrillation: a cautionary case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-27
    80岁瘦弱男性房颤患者接受脉冲场消融后24小时出现急性胃扩张和门静脉积气，经保守治疗好转，提示PFA可能引起短暂性胃肠动力障碍。
  • [Three-dimensional electroanatomic mapping in the electrophysiology lab: when, how and why? : A practical introduction for early-career electrophysiologists].
    Herzschrittmacherther Elektrophysiol · 2026-10-27
    三维电解剖标测是房颤消融、不典型房扑、室速等手术的重要工具，但需结合心内电图和电生理推理进行批判性解读。
  • Posterior Inter-Antral Linear Ablation Using Pulsed Field Energy: Electrophysiological Validation and Early Clinical Outcomes.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-27
    在阵发性房颤患者中，PVI联合PFA后壁inter-antral线性消融可实现可重复的传导阻滞，并较单纯PVI降低短期房性心律失常复发（6.2% vs 15.8%，HR 0.23）。
  • The Silent Face of Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review of Associated Factors, Clinical Phenotype, and Outcomes.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-27
    系统综述纳入23项研究、约17.4万例受试者，发现无症状性AF与男性、较慢心室率、长程持续性/永久性AF及更明显左房重构相关，其死亡率与血栓栓塞结局与有症状AF总体相当。
  • Drug Therapies and Incident Heart Failure in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-27
    在房颤患者中，仅厄贝沙坦有随机亚组证据提示可减少首次心衰住院（HR 0.81），其余药物证据多为观察性关联，预防心衰的药物治疗证据有限。
  • Obesity and Atrial Fibrillation: Weighing the Evidence.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-27
    肥胖是房颤可干预危险因素，但单纯减重随机试验未显著改善房颤结局，需综合管理心外膜脂肪和代谢风险。
  • Repeat Ablation for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: CFA/DOA-Guided Substrate Ablation Versus Re-PVI Alone in the Prematurely Terminated Randomized AF-CAM Trial.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-27
    在提前终止的随机试验中，持续性AF二次消融时在Re-PVI基础上加做CFA/DOA引导的基质消融，与单纯Re-PVI相比未能改善无房性心律失常生存（HR 1.07，P=0.85）。
  • NT-proBNP and Clinical Outcomes in Patients With HFrEF According to Atrial Fibrillation: Insights From QUEST.
    JACC Heart Fail · 2026-10-27
    在HFrEF患者中，基线NT-proBNP水平可强烈预测心血管事件风险且不受房颤状态影响，QLQX的疗效在不同NT-proBNP四分位间一致。
  • Assessment of Direct Oral Anticoagulant Plasma Concentrations Before Elective Electrical Cardioversion.
    Medicina (Kaunas) · 2026-10-27
    择期电复律前房颤患者中，随机时点DOAC血药浓度变异大，27.0%超过预期峰值上限，5.4%低于谷值下限，且部分患者剂量未按肾功能调整。
  • Trends in mortality involving atrial fibrillation/flutter and renal failure in the United States, 1999-2023: A nationwide multiple-cause-of-death analysis.
    Medicine (Baltimore) · 2026-10-27
    1999至2023年美国≥45岁成人中，死亡证明同时记录房颤/房扑与肾衰竭的年龄标化死亡率从6.3/10万升至20.6/10万，存在显著上升趋势且存在性别、种族和地理差异。
  • Atrial Fibrillation Burden as an Outcome in Clinical Trials.
    NEJM Evid · 2026-10-27
    本 workshop 探讨房颤负荷作为房颤干预试验主要终点的作用，强调其确定、定义和分析的关键考量及监管意义。
  • Atrial fibrillation is independently associated with impaired myocardial perfusion.
    PLoS One · 2026-10-27
    在疑似阻塞性冠心病患者中，房颤与充血性心肌血流受损独立相关，解读灌注影像时需考虑房颤的影响。
  • His Bundle Pacing via the Atrial Port of a Dual-Chamber ICD: Programming Solution for Undersensing.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-27
    一例永久性房颤患者经双腔ICD心房端口行希氏束起搏出现感知不足，通过重新编程利用远场信号避免导线翻修。
  • Marshall Vein Ethanol Infusion and Mitral Isthmus Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation With Durable Pulmonary Vein Isolation.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-27
    在持久性肺静脉隔离的持续性房颤患者中，重复消融时在左房后壁隔离基础上加做Marshall静脉乙醇输注和二尖瓣峡部消融，可降低房性快速性心律失常复发风险。
  • New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation After Typical Flutter Ablation: Risk-Stratified Monitoring Using Implantable Loop Recorders.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-27
    典型房扑消融后植入ILR持续监测，约三分之二患者检出房颤，多在术后数月出现；左房容积指数≥26 mL/m2和LVEF≤50%可独立预测房颤风险。
  • Conventional Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia Ablation: 16-Year Acute Outcomes and Pacemaker Requirement.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-27
    单中心16年814例常规（非三维标测）AVNRT消融，急性成功率90.3%，住院期起搏器植入率仅0.37%，3例起搏器患者随访心室起搏比例均为100%。

室性心律失常（3）

  • Human Engineered Heart Tissues Reproduce Trigger- and Substrate-Driven Mechanisms of Ventricular Tachycardia.
    Adv Sci (Weinh) · 2026-10-27
    人iPSC来源工程化心脏组织可重现触发与基质驱动的室性心动过速机制，表现为早期后除极诱发的自限性VT样事件及冷冻损伤后边界锚定的持续性转子。
  • A Conceptual Translational Bench-to-Bedside Cardiac Safety Framework for Predicting Drug-Induced QT Interval Prolongation from Molecular Structure to Clinical Data.
    Int J Mol Sci · 2026-10-27
    概念性转化工作流整合分子结构、体外药理、动物数据和临床暴露-反应模型，回顾性分析维拉帕米和多非利特，成功预测维拉帕米无临床相关QT延长、多非利特治疗浓度下QT延长超过10 ms阈值。
  • Frontiers in the Risk Stratification and Prevention of Sudden Cardiac Arrest and Death in Athletes.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-27
    本综述指出，运动员SCA/SCD风险评估需采用多模态个体化评估、纵向监测与共享决策，新兴计算工具证据尚有限。

器械治疗（6）

  • Case Report: Sepsis With Multisystemic Amyloid Light-Chain Amyloidosis.
    Case Rep Crit Care · 2026-10-27
    一例60岁女性AL型淀粉样变性多器官受累患者，化疗后发生心脏骤停并植入ICD，继发铜绿假单胞菌血流感染导致脓毒性休克，经积极支持治疗和感染源控制后血流动力学稳定并成功脱机。
  • Prognostic Value of the C-Reactive Protein-to-Albumin Ratio in Patients Hospitalized with Atrioventricular Block: Association with In-Hospital Mortality and Temporary Pacemaker Requirement.
    Medicina (Kaunas) · 2026-10-27
    在698例住院二度及以上房室传导阻滞患者中，C反应蛋白/白蛋白比值（CAR）升高与院内死亡和临时起搏器置入独立相关，但仅轻度提升预测区分度。
  • Late Obesity-Driven Subcutaneous ICD Geometric Failure: Salvage With Sub-Serratus Generator Repositioning.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-27
    一例肥胖患者体重显著增加后出现S-ICD晚期几何失效，通过胸肌下发生器重新定位改善PRAETORIAN评分和除颤阻抗，但阻抗仍升至130Ω，65J除颤成功。
  • Inappropriate ICD Therapy Due to Double Counting from a Dislodged Defibrillator Lead.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-27
  • Potential harms to rescuers during cardiac arrest response and resuscitation: a scoping review.
    Resusc Plus · 2026-10-27
    该范围综述纳入20项研究，提示心脏骤停施救过程中施救者受到的伤害总体罕见，但水上救援可发生致死性伤害，其他轻微伤害包括AED取出不当、ICD放电漏电及未使用PPE行CPR等。
  • [A deep learning-based method for rapid reconstruction and prediction of electromagnetic exposure in pacemaker patients].
    Sheng Wu Yi Xue Gong Cheng Xue Za Zhi · 2026-10-26
    基于3D U-Net的深度学习模型可快速预测起搏器患者微波炉泄漏电磁暴露，验证集相对误差<1%，单例预测仅0.93秒。

遗传与基础（5）

  • From Monogenic Variants to Polygenic Risk Scores in Inherited Cardiomyopathies: Clinical Utility, Ancestry Gaps, and Future Implementation in Arab Populations.
    Genes (Basel) · 2026-10-27
    综述指出遗传性心肌病多基因风险评分证据在HCM最强、DCM渐增、ACM/RCM弱，欧洲数据直接移植至阿拉伯人群存在校准与公平性风险，需本地化分阶段实施。
  • Beyond Conventional Autopsy: Recent Advances in Molecular Autopsy for Sudden Cardiac Death Investigation.
    Genes (Basel) · 2026-10-27
    分子尸检可识别常规尸检阴性的心脏性猝死病例中的致病基因变异，并通过级联筛查识别高危亲属，将法医遗传学延伸至预防性心血管医学。
  • Impact of aging on catecholaminergic ventricular arrhythmia and cardiac transcriptome of cardiac calsequestrin null mice.
    J Mol Cell Cardiol Plus · 2026-10-27
    衰老会加重Casq2缺失小鼠的CPVT表型，且triadin表达随年龄变化与表型严重程度相关，转录组分析揭示年龄依赖的基因表达改变。
  • Sinus Bradycardia Limiting Beta-Blockade in Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia: Atrial Leadless Pacing.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-27
    一例CPVT女性患者因严重窦性心动过缓无法启用β受体阻滞剂，植入心房无导线起搏器后成功上调nadolol剂量并联合氟卡尼，暂缓ICD植入。
  • Research trends and hotspot analysis of sudden cardiac death in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: A bibliometric analysis.
    Medicine (Baltimore) · 2026-10-27
    文献计量分析显示，肥厚型心肌病相关心脏性猝死研究在过去20年快速增长，由指南驱动，热点已从机制研究转向多模态风险预测、AI模型与靶向药物治疗。

其他（1）

  • Capture Verification in Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing: Reporting Gaps and a Practical Framework.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-27
    在46项可提取夺获信息的左束支区域起搏研究中，夺获验证报告严重不一致，仅1项研究区分LBBP、LVSP与不确定夺获，中位报告评分43.3分。

item.title: 2026-10-27 心脏电生理日报（30 篇）
item.description:
共 30 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（15）

  • The Illusion of Recovery From Atrial Fibrillation, a Review of Postcardioversion Anticoagulation Guidelines.
    Cardiol Rev · 2026-10-26
    房颤复律后即使恢复窦性心律，因心房顿抑血栓栓塞风险仍高，建议至少抗凝4周，后续是否继续取决于卒中风险而非心律状态。
  • Holter-Detected Arrhythmias in Acute Exacerbations of COPD: NT-proBNP Correlates and Hypercapnia Associated with COPD-Related Readmission.
    Int J Chron Obstruct Pulmon Dis · 2026-10-26
    AECOPD住院患者中60.4%经动态心电图检出至少一种心律失常，NT-proBNP与各类型心律失常独立相关，而高碳酸血症（而非心律失常）与COPD相关再入院独立相关。
  • Recurrence Rates and Outcomes After First Detected Atrial Fibrillation Episode in a Contemporary Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Center.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    在肥厚型心肌病首次检出房颤的患者中，即使转复窦律，中位171天内54%复发；导管消融者复发率27%，低于未节律控制（60%）和抗心律失常药（44%）。
  • Cardiometabolic Substrate Modification in Atrial Fibrillation: Obesity and Epicardial Adipose Tissue in the Era of Incretin-Based Therapies and Catheter Ablation.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    房颤是系统性心脏代谢疾病的心房表现，减重、GLP-1受体激动剂等代谢干预与导管消融互补，可改善节律控制，但消融后复发减少的证据多为非随机。
  • Hybrid Ablation for Patients with Persistent and Long-Standing Persistent Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    综述指出，对症状性、药物难治性持续性和长程持续性房颤，内外膜杂交消融较单纯导管消融能更有效维持无房颤，但创伤更大且主要不良事件风险达5-7.8%。
  • Primary Non-Adherence and Associated Factors in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation in Germany: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    德国房颤患者中约10.6%的首个口服抗凝药处方在30天内未配药，VKA未配药率最高，直接Xa因子抑制剂与较低未配药风险相关。
  • Evaluation of Clinical SYNTAX Score in Predicting New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation and Long-Term Prognosis in Patients Hospitalized with Non-ST Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    在979例NSTEMI患者中，临床SYNTAX评分（CSS）是院内新发房颤（NOAF）和长期不良结局的独立预测因子，其预测NOAF的AUC为0.724，优于解剖SYNTAX评分。
  • Clinical Outcomes of Transcatheter Versus Surgical Aortic Valve Replacement in Patients with Pure Native Aortic Regurgitation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    在纯原生主动脉瓣反流患者中，TAVR较SAVR缩短住院时间、减少围术期并发症与新发房颤，但瓣周漏与新永久起搏器植入显著增加，全因死亡率无差异。
  • Effects of Pulmonary Vein Isolation on Left Atrial Hemodynamic and Mechanical Function: Insights from Advanced and Emerging Echocardiographic Parameters in Responders and Non-Responders.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    PVI术后12个月，复发者左房重构指标恶化数值上大于未复发者，但经多重比较校正后均无统计学显著性。
  • Semaglutide in Atrial Arrhythmias: State of the Art and Future Perspectives.
    J Pers Med · 2026-10-26
    本综述指出，司美格鲁肽等GLP-1受体激动剂在血糖控制之外可能具有上游抗心律失常作用，或成为房颤综合管理的新策略，但尚缺乏硬终点证据。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion with the Watchman FLX Device: A Single-Centre Retrospective Analysis of Procedural and One-Year Clinical Outcomes.
    Med Sci (Basel) · 2026-10-26
    单中心100例非瓣膜性房颤患者植入Watchman FLX装置，手术成功率100%，围术期主要并发症7%（以出血为主），1年卒中1%、死亡11%。
  • Association of MASLD With Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Catheter Ablation: A Meta-Analysis.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-26
    合并6项研究2921例房颤消融患者，MASLD与术后房颤复发风险显著增加相关（HR 1.91），阵发性和持续性房颤中均一致。
  • Pulmonary Vein Isolation for Atrial Fibrillation in Brugada Syndrome: A Meta-Analysis.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-26
    在Brugada综合征或Brugada型心电图合并房颤患者中，肺静脉隔离术后82%无房颤复发，不恰当ICD放电风险差为-0.35，手术安全性可接受。
  • The Effectiveness and Safety of Deep Sedation Protocols for Pulsed Field Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-26
    在PFA房颤消融中，氟比洛芬酯联合方案与右美托咪定方案达到目标镇静的比例显著高于低剂量咪达唑仑方案，但右美托咪定术中低血压更多。
  • Temporal trends in oral anticoagulant prescribing in patients with atrial fibrillation and advanced chronic kidney disease: insights from the CRAFT registry.
    Pol Arch Intern Med · 2026-10-26

室性心律失常（4）

  • The quality and reliability of short videos about myocarditis on Bilibili and TikTok: cross-sectional study.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-10-26
    TikTok和Bilibili上心肌炎相关短视频整体质量欠佳，医疗专业人员制作的视频质量更高，但预防和流行病学内容覆盖不足。
  • Ticagrelor-Induced Bradyarrhythmias in Acute Coronary Syndrome: A Case Series of Three Patients.
    Cureus · 2026-10-26
    三例急性冠脉综合征患者服用替格瑞洛后出现严重缓慢性心律失常，停药并换用普拉格雷后两例恢复，一例需永久起搏器。
  • AAOLCA in a Child Presenting With Fever and Cardiac Arrest: Diagnostic Overlap With Acute Myocarditis.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-26
    11岁儿童发热后心脏骤停，初诊拟诊急性心肌炎，因非典型特征进一步检查确诊左冠状动脉异常起源于主动脉（AAOLCA），手术去顶后康复。
  • Sedation Versus General Anesthesia During Pediatric Electrophysiology Studies: A Paired Comparison.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-26
    儿童室上速电生理检查中，程序性镇静较全身麻醉总体心动过速诱发率更高（78.4% vs 56.9%，p=0.007），但亚组差异未达统计学意义。

器械治疗（3）

  • A Post-market Decision-Making Framework for Medical Devices in Hospital Settings: the THE Mini-HTA Tool.
    Appl Health Econ Health Policy · 2026-10-26
    THE Mini-HTA工具在意大利某三级医院对两种ICD进行上市后评估，初步证明其操作可行，能清晰呈现比较优势来源与残余差异大小。
  • Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Long-Term Mortality in Patients with Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    基于3321例ICD/CRT-D患者，随机生存森林模型在内外验证中C-index达0.71/0.70，高危组死亡风险为低危组4.5倍，LVEDD是最强预测因子。
  • Pacemaker-Facilitated Beta-Blocker Therapy for Symptomatic Concomitant Myocardial Bridge and Vasospastic Angina.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-26
    一例56岁女性慢性左束支传导阻滞患者，因劳力性心绞痛经侵入性冠脉生理学检查确诊左前降支心肌桥合并可诱发的痉挛性心绞痛，双腔起搏器辅助下恢复β受体阻滞剂治疗并缓解心绞痛。

心力衰竭与代谢（1）

  • Development and Population-Based Prognostic Utility Assessment of an ICD-10-CM-Based Prediction Model to Identify Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction: Discrimination Performance and Population-Based Evaluation in 83,357 Patients with Acute Coronary Syndrome.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    基于ICD-10-CM代码和两项临床变量构建的LVEF降低预测模型在83,357例ACS患者中区分度中等（AUC 0.738），预测LVEF降低与全因死亡风险升高2.45倍相关。

遗传与基础（7）

  • NOR-1 is an upstream regulator of Ca2+ homeostasis and calmodulin kinase II-dependent arrhythmogenesis.
    Cardiovasc Res · 2026-10-26
    NOR-1通过上调钙调控蛋白和CAMKII氧化导致钙稳态异常，从而增加室性心律失常易感性，CAMKII抑制可减轻心律失常。
  • Naxos disease: current insights from early clinical observations to genetics and precision medicine.
    Intern Emerg Med · 2026-10-26
    Naxos病作为桥粒性心肌病原型，近四十年从罕见遗传综合征演变为精准医学范本，JUP、DSP、DSC2基因型差异影响心室受累与预后。
  • The Role of the OBSCN Gene in Cardiomyopathy: A Review of Molecular Mechanisms and Clinical Significance.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    OBSCN基因是新兴但特征不完全的心肌病相关基因，截短变异以意义不明变异为主，肥厚型心肌病最常见，需进一步临床与机制研究。
  • Delayed Diagnosis of Hereditary Transthyretin Cardiac Amyloidosis Presenting with Autonomic Neuropathy: A Case Report.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    一例携带罕见转甲状腺素蛋白p.Gly67Val变异的64岁男性，以自主神经病为首发表现，因早期症状不典型及检测可及性差而延误遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变诊断。
  • From Diagnosis to Treatment of Arrhythmic Mitral Valve Prolapse and Mitral Annular Disjunction.
    J Cardiovasc Dev Dis · 2026-10-26
    二尖瓣脱垂（MVP）合并二尖瓣环分离（MAD）可致严重室性心律失常和心脏性猝死（SCD），但机制未明，需个体化风险分层。
  • Post-Translational Protein Acylation in Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Cardiovasc Transl Res · 2026-10-26
    本综述系统梳理了多种蛋白赖氨酸酰化修饰（乙酰化、丙酰化、乳酸化等）通过调控离子通道、线粒体代谢、氧化应激、炎症及成纤维细胞活化参与心房重构与 AF 发生，并探讨了靶向酰化相关酶的潜在治疗价值。
  • Prediction of New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Acute Myocardial Infarction: A Machine Learning Approach.
    Med Sci (Basel) · 2026-10-26
    在150例急性心肌梗死患者中，机器学习模型预测新发房颤的ROC-AUC达0.991，E/e'比值、左室质量指数等为关键预测因子。

item.title: 2026-10-25 心脏电生理日报（45 篇）
item.description:
共 45 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（25）

  • Prospective multicenter feasibility study of omnipolar near-field peak-frequency mapping for slow-pathway localization in typical atrioventricular nodal re-entrant tachycardia.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-10-25
    在典型AVNRT患者中，OTNF峰值频率标测可识别慢径消融靶点，有效消融位点与最高PF区一致率达90%，但阈值性能需独立验证。
  • Premature ventricular contractions: pathophysiology, prognostic impact, and management.
    Eur Heart J Open · 2026-10-25
    室性早搏在结构性心脏病患者中与不良预后相关，但抑制室早的临床试验未改善结局；无结构性心脏病者预后意义不明，治疗以症状为导向，导管消融优于药物。
  • Cerebral Safety of Two Pulsed Field Ablation Workflows for Pulmonary Vein Isolation: Results From the Randomized TWOSOME MRI Study.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-25
    随机对照TWOSOME MRI亚组中，两种脉冲场消融流程行肺静脉隔离后急性无症状脑栓塞发生率均为低水平（6%），无持续性脑病灶及PFA相关神经并发症。
  • Cavotricuspid Isthmus Ablation Using a Variable Loop Pulsed Field Ablation Catheter: A Single-Center Descriptive Analysis.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-25
    可变环脉冲场消融导管用于三尖瓣峡部消融在23例患者中实现急性双向阻滞，无并发症，随访218天仅1例疑似典型房扑复发。
  • Coupling Interval Variability of Outflow Tract Premature Ventricular Contractions: A Poincaré Plot-Based Assessment.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-25
    在60例接受电解剖标测与导管消融的室性早搏患者中，基于Holter的Poincaré图分析显示，联律间期变异度（ΔCI）<100 ms对右室流出道（RVOT）起源具有100%特异度但敏感度仅25%，窄PVC簇提示RVOT定位。
  • Investigating the TASK1 potassium channel in equine atrial myocardium as a potential treatment target for atrial fibrillation.
    Br J Pharmacol · 2026-10-24
    马TASK1钾通道与人类高度保守且心房富集，在体抑制可延长马心房有效不应期，支持其作为房颤心房选择性治疗靶点。
  • Coffee and the Risk of Atrial Fibrillation
    Cardiology Research · 2026-10-24
    适量饮用常规咖啡可能降低房颤等房性心律失常风险，且对室性心律失常患者安全，医院应重新考虑仅提供无咖啡因咖啡的政策。
  • Marked QT Prolongation and Torsades de Pointes Following Pulsed Field Ablation for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation
    Cureus · 2026-10-24
  • Concomitant Balloon-in-Basket Pulsed Field Ablation and Next-Generation Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion: Acute Procedural Success and Early Safety and Effectiveness results from the Prospective Multicenter CLEAR Study.
    Europace · 2026-10-24
  • Safety, Efficacy and Cost of Same-Day Discharge after Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Sub-study of the Multicentre SENTINEL Registry.
    Europace · 2026-10-24
  • Quality of life after cryoballoon vs. radiofrequency ablation in atrial fibrillation: a subanalysis of the FREEZE cohort study.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-24
    在症状性房颤患者中，冷冻球囊与射频消融均显著改善生活质量，但冷冻球囊在疼痛/不适、EQ-VAS和EuroQol 5D评分上改善更明显。
  • Epicardial adipose tissue in obesity-related heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and atrial fibrillation: mechanisms, imaging, and therapeutic modulation.
    Front Endocrinol (Lausanne) · 2026-10-24
    心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）是肥胖相关HFpEF与AF交互中的可测量表型，局部实验证据在AF中强于HFpEF，但改变EAT本身能否带来临床获益尚需纵向研究。
  • SPISE for predicting the presence of atrial fibrillation in patients with coronary artery disease: a comparative analysis with TyG index
    Front Endocrinol (Lausanne) · 2026-10-24
  • Open wavefront ablation terminates rotor-driven atrial fibrillation
    Front Netw Physiol · 2026-10-24
  • Vagal Response and Cough Reflex During Atrial Fibrillation Ablation Under Deep Sedation: A Comparison Across Pulsed Field Ablation Systems.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-24
    在深度镇静下房颤PFA消融中，三种PFA系统的迷走反应发生率无显著差异，但PULSESELECT的咳嗽反射发生率显著更高。
  • Massive Left Atrial Thrombosis Shortly After Radiofrequency Catheter Ablation: Implications of Reduced Flow Dynamics Detected by Four-Dimensional Flow Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-24
    一例持续性房颤再次射频消融后5天，在持续抗凝下仍于左房顶部消融部位形成巨大血栓，4D flow MRI显示该区域血流速度减低。
  • 2026 Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) Guidelines (Part I) on Epidemiology, Detection/Screening and Integrated Patient Care in Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-24
    2026 APHRS 房颤指南第一部分发布，聚焦亚太地区流行病学、筛查检测与整合式管理，为区域房颤诊疗提供循证推荐。
  • 2026 Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) Guidelines (Part IV) on Comprehensive Lifestyle Risk Factor and Comorbidity Management in Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-24
    2026 APHRS 指南第四部分系统提出房颤患者生活方式危险因素与合并症的综合管理路径，强调将生活方式干预作为房颤照护核心并兼顾亚太地区资源差异。
  • 2026 Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) Guidelines (Part III) on Rate and Rhythm Control in Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-24
  • Quantifying the Functional Effect of Transmural Interpolation Strategies on Atrial Wave Propagation Using a Custom Open-Source Pipeline.
    J Vis Exp · 2026-10-24
    在6例基于CT的左房模型中，跨壁纤维插值策略使纤维方向平均偏差8.06°，并延迟区域1激动2.0 ms（对应6.1 ms，P=0.031），提示插值选择对房颤计算模型有功能影响。
  • Prospective evaluation of stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation for refractory ventricular tachycardia: initial clinical experience in Japan.
    Jpn J Radiol · 2026-10-24
    在日本难治性室速患者中，立体定向心律失常放射消融（STAR）12个月内未出现≥3级治疗相关不良事件，但大靶体积患者随访24个月出现左室射血分数进行性下降。
  • Mindfulness-based perioperative care, sleep architecture, autonomic regulation, and early atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: a prospective observational cohort study.
    Psychol Health Med · 2026-10-24
    围术期正念护理与房颤射频消融术后早期房性快速性心律失常复发率较低相关（9.7% vs 17.7%），但差异未达统计学显著（RR 0.55，95%CI 0.22-1.38）。
  • [Clinical characteristics and prognosis of patients with atrial functional mitral regurgitation]
    PubMed · 2026-10-24
    与室性功能性二尖瓣反流相比，房性功能性二尖瓣反流多见于高龄、女性及房颤患者，心衰症状较少，全因死亡与心血管死亡或心衰住院率均更低。
  • A Case Report of Lyme Carditis Presenting as New-Onset Atrial Flutter in the Emergency Department.
    Wilderness Environ Med · 2026-10-24
    一例早期播散性莱姆病老年患者以新发心房扑动伴快速心室率就诊，抗生素治疗后房扑消失且未复发。
  • The evolution and future of conduction system pacing.
    Nat Rev Cardiol · 2026-10-23
    本综述系统梳理了传导系统起搏从希氏束起搏向左束支区域起搏的演变，并介绍Bachmann束区域起搏作为心房生理性起搏的新方向，指出其可能有助于预防房颤。

室性心律失常（3）

  • Continuous Stellate Ganglion Block Bridging to Cardiac Sympathetic Denervation in a Long QT Syndrome Neonate.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-25
    新生儿先天性长QT综合征经药物和起搏器治疗仍反复发生尖端扭转型室速，连续经皮左侧星状神经节阻滞可有效抑制心律失常，作为桥接至电视辅助胸腔镜左心交感神经去神经术，术后24个月无复发。
  • Transient ST-T Changes During Submaximal Exercise Revealing Anomalous Right Coronary Artery Origin in an Asymptomatic Athlete.
    Case Rep Cardiol · 2026-10-24
    一例22岁无症状运动员在次极量运动及恢复期出现一过性ST-T改变，而峰值运动正常，由此发现右冠状动脉异常起源于左冠窦，提示次极量运动心电图在赛前筛查中的潜在价值。
  • Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia unmasked by beta-blockade in pheochromocytoma presenting as hypertensive optic neuropathy: a case report and literature review.
    Front Med (Lausanne) · 2026-10-24
    51岁女性嗜铬细胞瘤患者，在未先用α受体阻滞剂的情况下使用β受体阻滞剂后诱发双向性室速，经α受体阻滞及肿瘤切除后心律失常未再复发。

器械治疗（8）

  • Understanding veteran perspectives surrounding implantable cardioverter- defibrillator decision-making.
    Am Heart J Plus · 2026-10-25
    13名退伍军人定性访谈显示，ICD决策受生活质量价值观、精神信仰及不愿侵入性干预疾病进程影响，强调个体化医患沟通与定制决策支持工具。
  • Preprocedural Computed Tomography Guidance Improves Accuracy of Right Ventricular Septal Lead Placement in Pacemaker Implantation.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-25
    术前CT引导可提高右室间隔部起搏导线植入的准确性（93.0% vs 55.6%），缩短起搏QRS时限，降低辐射剂量和囊袋血肿发生率。
  • Conservative management of a dislodged leadless pacemaker wedged in the pulmonary artery assessed by pulmonary perfusion scintigraphy: a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-24
    84岁高龄女性无导线起搏器植入后发生装置脱落并栓塞至肺动脉，因高风险选择保守治疗，系列肺灌注显像显示1年内双肺血流分布稳定，随访3年无症状。
  • Successful extravascular implantable cardioverter defibrillator implantation in a patient with ankylosing spondylitis and severe thoracic deformity: a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-24
    一例57岁强直性脊柱炎合并严重胸廓畸形、扩张型心肌病的患者，经术前CT评估与个体化体位及解剖策略，成功植入胸骨下EV-ICD，6个月随访参数稳定、无误放电。
  • Optimal depolarization sequence for cardiac resynchronization therapy patients.
    Eur Heart J Open · 2026-10-24
    在121例CRT患者中，CineECG衍生的植入前心尖-基底去极化梯度可独立预测6个月左室逆重构，梯度越小反应越好。
  • Prognostic value of the inflammatory burden index in predicting 1-year mortality in patients undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy for heart failure.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-24
    在525例接受CRT的心衰患者中，炎症负荷指数（IBI）和CRP均为1年死亡的独立预测因子，且预测价值相当，均可提升基线临床模型的区分度。
  • A Novel Method for Assessing Left Bundle Branch Capture Using the Bidirectional Conduction Time Difference Between Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing and Coronary Sinus Leads.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-24
    在LOT-CRT患者中，LBBAP与CS导联双向传导时间差ΔLBB-CS≥21.5 ms可辅助确认左束支夺获，基线LBBB者以20.5 ms为界诊断准确性更高（AUC 0.99）。
  • Evaluation of Acute Electrical and Hemodynamic Improvement During Left Bundle-Branch Area Pacing Modalities for Resynchronization Therapy.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-24
    在24例心衰合并LBBB患者中，选择性左束支起搏的急性血流动力学获益最大（ΔSBP 16.3±5.2 mmHg），且血流动力学最优的AV间期比QRS最窄的AV间期短18-29 ms。

遗传与基础（7）

  • Stable truncating mutations in plakophilin-2 induce arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy-like phenotypes in adult zebrafish.
    iScience · 2026-10-25
    研究利用CRISPR-Cas9构建斑马鱼pkp2截短突变模型，再现了ACM样表型，包括收缩功能受损、心律失常和运动诱导性猝死。
  • MAPK15 induces cardiomyocyte senescence and atrial fibrillation by promoting mitochondrial calcium overload via palmitoylating Mcub at the C91 residue.
    Cardiovasc Res · 2026-10-24
    MAPK15通过棕榈酰化Mcub C91位点促进线粒体钙超载，诱导心房肌细胞衰老和房颤，抑制该通路可逆转。
  • Atypical echocardiographic phenotype of end-stage hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: a case series.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-24
    三例终末期HCM超声表型不典型，经基因检测确诊，提示多模态影像与基因检测在鉴别诊断中的价值。
  • Beyond the light-driven pacemaker: the suprachiasmatic nucleus as a dynamic coordinator of environmental cues.
    Front Neurosci · 2026-10-24
    视交叉上核并非仅被动接受光授时，而是整合光、代谢、星形胶质细胞和温度线索的动态网络，其核心VIP/GRP神经元优先接收视网膜输入，而摄食信号更多调节SCN活动而非重置核心分子钟。
  • Sex Differences in the Associations of Age-Related Genetic Predisposition With Incident Atrial Fibrillation: A Prospective Cohort Study.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-24
    在UK Biobank中，AF多基因风险与发病的年龄相关关联存在性别差异：男性40-49岁HR较高，女性60-69岁HR较高，提示需按年龄和性别个体化风险分层。
  • Clinical integration of artificial intelligence for diagnosis, risk prediction and management of rare cardiovascular diseases.
    J Basic Clin Physiol Pharmacol · 2026-10-24
    AI技术可提升罕见心血管病的诊断准确性、风险分层和个体化治疗决策，但临床落地仍需标准化多中心数据和前瞻性验证。
  • eNOS uncoupling drives oxidative stress and arrhythmogenic vulnerability in experimental hypothyroidism.
    Redox Biol · 2026-10-24
    实验性甲状腺功能减退小鼠中，eNOS解偶联驱动氧化应激和致心律失常易感性，恢复eNOS偶联可减少心律失常。

其他（2）

  • Artifactual Contact Force Rise During High-Power Radiofrequency Delivery With the QDOT MICRO Catheter: A Comparative Study Using Non-Contact Tests.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-25
    QDOT MICRO导管在高功率射频消融时出现功率依赖性伪差性接触力升高，90W时76%病例接触力升高≥5g，而Thermocool SmartTouch SF导管无此现象。
  • Fatigue, Hypertension, Dizziness, Anxiety, Depression, Musculoskeletal and Sleep Disorders, and Cardiac Arrhythmia: A Patient with Post-COVID-19 Condition in Dental Practice: 1-Year Follow-Up
    Journal of Diagnostics and Treatment of Oral and Maxillofacial Pathology · 2026-10-24
    一例67岁女性新冠后遗症患者随访1年，合并心律失常、焦虑及多种躯体症状，抗凝与血压管理是安全牙科治疗的关键。

item.title: 2026-10-24 心脏电生理日报（96 篇）
item.description:
共 96 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（52）

  • Investigating the TASK1 potassium channel in equine atrial myocardium as a potential treatment target for atrial fibrillation.
    Br J Pharmacol · 2026-10-24
    马TASK1钾通道与人类高度保守且主要表达于心房，在体抑制可显著延长心房有效不应期，支持其作为房颤心房选择性治疗靶点。
  • Quality of life after cryoballoon vs. radiofrequency ablation in atrial fibrillation: a subanalysis of the FREEZE cohort study
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-24
  • Epicardial adipose tissue in obesity-related heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and atrial fibrillation: mechanisms, imaging, and therapeutic modulation
    Front Endocrinol (Lausanne) · 2026-10-24
  • SPISE for predicting the presence of atrial fibrillation in patients with coronary artery disease: a comparative analysis with TyG index
    Front Endocrinol (Lausanne) · 2026-10-24
  • Open wavefront ablation terminates rotor-driven atrial fibrillation
    Front Netw Physiol · 2026-10-24
  • Mindfulness-based perioperative care, sleep architecture, autonomic regulation, and early atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: a prospective observational cohort study.
    Psychol Health Med · 2026-10-24
    围术期正念护理与房颤射频消融术后早期房性心动过速复发率数值更低（9.7% vs 17.7%，RR 0.55）相关，但差异无统计学意义。
  • [Clinical characteristics and prognosis of patients with atrial functional mitral regurgitation]
    PubMed · 2026-10-24
    与室性功能性二尖瓣反流相比，房性功能性二尖瓣反流多见于高龄、女性及房颤患者，心衰症状较少，全因死亡和心血管死亡或心衰住院率均更低。
  • A Case Report of Lyme Carditis Presenting as New-Onset Atrial Flutter in the Emergency Department.
    Wilderness Environ Med · 2026-10-24
    一例早期播散性莱姆病患者以新发心房扑动伴快速心室率就诊，抗生素治疗后房扑消失且未复发，提示莱姆心脏炎可表现为房性心律失常。
  • Multimorbidity and atrial fibrillation: Clinical impact and future perspectives in atrial fibrillation care
    2026-10-23
  • Design and rationale of a multicenter randomized trial assessing strategies for catheter ablation of persistent atrial fibrillation- The STAR AF 3 trial.
    Am Heart J · 2026-10-23
    STAR AF 3 试验比较持续性房颤首次消融时 PVI alone 与 PVI+驱动灶消融或 PVI+后壁隔离的策略，已入组 617 例患者，主要终点为单次术后 91 天至 18 个月内心房快速性心律失常复发时间。
  • Predictive Value of the HALP Score for Post-Operative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft Surgery.
    Angiology · 2026-10-23
    在448例CABG患者中，HALP评分对术后房颤的预测能力优于其他营养炎症指标，整合HALP的模型AUC达0.897，可用于术前风险分层。
  • Association of left atrial low-voltage area burden and reservoir strain with 12-month recurrence after first radiofrequency ablation for persistent atrial fibrillation: evaluation of a combined model
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-23
    在持续性房颤首次射频消融患者中，左房低电压区负荷增高与储备应变降低均独立预测12个月复发，联合模型区分度优于临床模型，但较临床模型加低电压区负荷的增益不确定。
  • Heart Failure Progression in the Setting of Persistent Atrial Fibrillation, Frequent Premature Ventricular Complexes, and Malignancy-Related Limitations to Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy: A Case Report.
    Clin Case Rep · 2026-10-23
    一例持续性房颤合并频发室早及恶性肿瘤限制指南导向药物治疗的心衰患者，经房室结消融联合CRT-D植入后实现持久心率控制并支持心室功能恢复。
  • Recurrence analysis of cardiac arrhythmias: A systematic review of methods, substrate characterisation and clinical translation.
    Comput Biol Med · 2026-10-23
    系统综述纳入49项研究，发现复发量化分析（RQA）在房颤信号分析中方法学异质性大，阈值选择缺乏标准，临床转化证据不足，仅1项前瞻性研究指导消融。
  • Clinician adherence to peri-procedural warfarin bridging guidelines for patients with atrial fibrillation enrolled in an anticoagulation management service.
    Crit Pathw Cardiol · 2026-10-23
    在CHA₂DS₂-VASc≥5的房颤患者中，遵循机构指南不桥接华法林与桥接相比，无血栓栓塞事件增加，且出血事件有减少趋势。
  • Concomitant Balloon-in-Basket Pulsed Field Ablation and Next-Generation Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion: Acute Procedural Success and Early Safety and Effectiveness results from the Prospective Multicenter CLEAR Study
    Europace · 2026-10-23
  • Safety, Efficacy and Cost of Same-Day Discharge after Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Sub-study of the Multicentre SENTINEL Registry
    Europace · 2026-10-23
    在SENTINEL多中心注册研究中，房颤脉冲场消融后当日出院安全可行，不良事件与住院费用均较低。
  • Transitioning towards life-cycle management and burden monitoring of atrial fibrillation.
    Expert Rev Cardiovasc Ther · 2026-10-23
    房颤应从发作控制转向全生命周期管理，综合危险因素干预、消融及负担监测以延缓疾病进展。
  • Efficacy and safety of conscious/deep sedation versus general anesthesia in pulsed field ablation for atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-23
    在房颤脉冲场消融中，与全麻相比，清醒/深度镇静可缩短总手术时间约7.7分钟，且急性肺静脉隔离成功率和安全性相当。
  • Leadless Atrial Pacing Targeting Bachmann Bundle for Atrial Resynchronization: A Single Center Registry.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在21例窦房结功能障碍伴房间传导延迟患者中，靶向Bachmann束的无导线心房起搏植入成功率为81%，可显著缩短P波时限和左房传导时间，且无并发症。
  • Three ablation strategies using very high-power short-duration catheter in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation: The Q-INDEX randomized trial.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在阵发性房颤PVI中，全程vHPSD（90W/4s）较AI引导将消融时间缩短逾一半，但1年无房性心律失常率最低（77.6% vs 92.0%），混合策略兼顾效率与疗效。
  • Pulmonary Vein Isolation With Contact-Force-Sensing Large-Tip Focal Pulsed Field Ablation Catheter With 3D Mapping for Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation: Omny-IRE 12-month Results.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    Omny-IRE研究显示，使用接触力感知大端电极脉冲场消融导管联合三维标测行肺静脉隔离，12个月无房性心律失常生存率为82.5%，严重不良事件发生率2.9%。
  • CATHETER ABLATION VERSUS SHAM FOR SYMPTOMATIC ATRIAL FIBRILLATION: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND BAYESIAN META-ANALYSIS OF RANDOMIZED TRIALS.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在症状性房颤患者中，导管消融较假手术可降低房颤复发（RR 0.49）并很可能改善生活质量（AFEQT提高13.5分），但QoL获益幅度不确定。
  • Non-Invasive Stimulation of the Median Nerve: Neuromodulation to Reduce Atrial Arrhythmias in Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation (The Randomized BEAT-AF Pilot Study).
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在阵发性房颤患者中，无创正中神经刺激可降低房性早搏负荷并改善症状，但房颤负荷下降未达统计学显著。
  • Bench Evaluation of Pulsed Field Ablation Interference With Left Atrial Appendage Closure Devices.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
  • Effect of telemedicine-based integrated management of atrial fibrillation in village clinics on recurrent nonfatal cardiovascular events: a secondary analysis of the MIRACLE-AF trial.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在乡村老年房颤患者中，基于远程医疗的整合管理虽使复发性非致死性心血管事件方向性减少（HR 0.76），但未达统计学显著性（P=0.053）。
  • Association of Left Atrial Intramyocardial Fat Infiltration With Atrial Arrhythmia Recurrence After Pulsed-Field Ablation for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在持续性房颤脉冲场消融患者中，左房心肌内脂肪浸润体积较大与术后房性心律失常复发独立相关，而左房心外膜脂肪体积无此关联。
  • Sex-based differences in bi-atrial voltage in atrial fibrillation: a multimodal and digital twin approach to distinguish physiological variation from pathological remodelling.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    女性房颤患者双心房电压低于男性，但基质特征和房颤机制无差异，提示电压差异可能反映生理变异而非病理重构，需性别特异性电压阈值。
  • Atrial Fibrillation Pattern and Outcomes After Contemporary Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在当代左心耳封堵术后，房颤类型独立预测残余临床风险，非阵发性房颤卒中风险增加64%，尤其在装置周围漏或装置相关血栓亚组中术后180-540天风险更高。
  • Left Atrial Reservoir Strain To Identify Advanced Atrial Cardiomyopathy in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在症状性房颤且左室射血分数保留的患者中，左房储备应变（LASr）降低与更进展的心房心肌病相关，表现为左房顺应性下降、压力升高、电压降低及NT-proBNP升高和左房容积增大。
  • Pulmonary vein narrowing after voltage-guided adjunctive pulmonary vein sleeve pulsed field ablation.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在147例首次接受五分支PFA肺静脉隔离的房颤患者中，电压引导的附加肺静脉袖套PFA约6个月后未观察到显著肺静脉狭窄，各肺静脉最大横截面积缩小中位数为4.0%-6.4%。
  • Zero-fluoroscopy approach to left atrial appendage closure using intracardiac echo guidance.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    本研究显示，在214例接受Watchman装置左心耳封堵术的患者中，采用心腔内超声引导且不使用透视的零透视方法，94.8%的病例成功完成，装置植入成功率99.1%，45天装置周围漏发生率为11.6%，围术期并发症仅2例，表明该技术安全可行。
  • Day-Night Patterns of Wearable-Derived Electrocardiographic Age and Left Atrial Remodeling in Atrial Fibrillation-Naïve Individuals.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在499例无房颤者中，可穿戴AI-ECG年龄呈现可重复的昼夜节律，节律紊乱表型与左房扩大相关（OR 3.68），但个体分类可重复性不足。
  • Epicardial Closure for Peridevice Leaks from Endocardial Left Atrial Appendage Closure - Early LARIAT-4-PDL Registry Results.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    LARIAT心外膜缝合术可成功闭合内镜下左心耳封堵术后≥3mm的器械周围漏，10例均急性成功，无差异。
  • Sequential multimodality imaging-guided transseptal strategy for cryoballoon ablation in cor triatriatum sinister.
    Int J Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-10-23
    在左侧三房心合并阵发性房颤患者中，序贯应用CCT、实时TEE、造影与透视指导房间隔穿刺，单次穿刺成功进入含肺静脉腔并完成4支肺静脉冷冻球囊隔离，无并发症。
  • Inferolateral ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction Secondary to Suspected Coronary Embolism in a Patient with Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation: A Case Report.
    Int Med Case Rep J · 2026-10-23
    76岁阵发性房颤患者发生下侧壁STEMI，冠脉造影示右室后侧支远端100%血栓性闭塞而其余冠脉无明显狭窄，符合Shibata标准，考虑冠脉栓塞，继续长期抗凝1个月随访无症状。
  • Frequent Premature Ventricular Complexes and Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-23
    房颤消融患者中频发室早（PVC）基线患病率高，但术后早期未见频发PVC增加，2年随访中≥1% PVC比例显著上升，基线PVC负荷和高血压是预测因素。
  • Electrocardiogram Embeddings Beyond Chronological Age for Prediagnostic Cognitive Impairment and Dementia: Development and External Validation Study.
    J Med Internet Res · 2026-10-23
    在韩国双中心队列中，常规12导联心电图的基础模型嵌入可提供独立于实际年龄的预测信息，用于识别未来10年内诊断为认知障碍或痴呆的患者，且预测信号在诊断前1-3年及0-1年窗口增强。
  • Trends in Oral Anticoagulant Prescribing for Atrial Fibrillation and Active Cancer in UK Primary Care.
    JACC Adv · 2026-10-23
    英国初级保健数据显示，2010至2023年合并活动性癌症的房颤患者口服抗凝药启动率增长4.32倍，但肺癌、转移性癌症及痴呆患者启动率仍较低。
  • Decoding Atrial Fibrillation Heterogeneity: A Nationwide Phenome-Wide Association Study in England.
    JACC Adv · 2026-10-23
    英国全国性Phe-WAS显示新诊断AF患者5年内非心血管合并症负担显著，且存在性别与年龄异质性，23种表型为潜在新发现。
  • The Vein of Marshall Promotes Re-Entry After Pulmonary Vein Reconnection.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-23
    在硅胶双心房模型中，完整CS-VoM-LA心外膜连接使肺静脉重连后持续性折返性房速的易感性较无连接时提高22.7个百分点，提示VoM是WACA不完全后的关键心外膜驱动因素。
  • Pulsed Field Ablation of the Left Atrial Appendage Before Mechanical Closure to Reduce Peri-Device Leak (STUN-AF).
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-23
    在PFA联合LAAC的患者中，附加左心耳脉冲场消融可显著降低3-4个月和12个月时左心耳通畅率（残余漏），且不增加器械相关血栓风险。
  • Neighborhood Disadvantage and Unequal Detection of Atrial Fibrillation
    JAMA Network Open · 2026-10-23
  • Race- and Neighborhood-Level Social Determinants of Health in Diagnosis and Treatment of Atrial Fibrillation
    JAMA Network Open · 2026-10-23
    在费城地区医保人群中，非西班牙裔黑人相比白人房颤诊断几率更低（OR 0.91），且随社区社会障碍指数升高，黑人诊断几率进一步下降（OR 0.94），而白人则上升（OR 1.05）；确诊后抗凝处方率无种族差异。
  • Co-Designing a Digital Platform for the Management of Modifiable Risk Factors and Comorbidities in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation: Mixed Methods Usability Study.
    JMIR Hum Factors · 2026-10-23
    在22例房颤患者中，共同设计的可调控危险因素数字平台SUS中位评分78.8分，可用性高于平均水平，患者重视清晰布局、正向内容、个性化信息与个体化医疗建议。
  • Trends in mortality involving atrial fibrillation/flutter and renal failure in the United States, 1999–2023
    Medicine · 2026-10-23
    1999至2023年美国≥45岁成人中，死亡证明同时记录房颤/房扑和肾衰竭的年龄标化死亡率从6.3/10万升至20.6/10万，存在显著上升趋势，且存在性别、种族和地理差异。
  • The evolution and future of conduction system pacing.
    Nat Rev Cardiol · 2026-10-23
    本综述系统梳理了传导系统起搏从希氏束起搏向左束支区域起搏的演进，并介绍Bachmann束区域起搏作为心房生理性起搏新策略，指出其可能预防房颤。
  • Diagnostic Accuracy of Wearable Technologies for Atrial Fibrillation Detection in Adults: A Systematic Review
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-23
    可穿戴设备（单导联ECG、PPG或双模态）在成人房颤检测中具有中等诊断准确性，但研究间异质性大，无法进行荟萃分析。
  • Aveir VR for Atrial Leadless Pacing in Young Patients.
    Pediatr Cardiol · 2026-10-23
    在5例14-17岁男性窦房结功能障碍患者中，经股静脉途径成功植入Aveir VR无导线起搏器于心房，随访1-23个月参数稳定。
  • The "Reverse Break" Pattern in Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome: A Rare Electrocardiographic Marker for Right Posteroseptal Accessory Pathways
    Recent Advances in Clinical Trials · 2026-10-23
    一例60岁女性WPW综合征患者，体表心电图胸前导联出现罕见的“反向断裂”征，经三维电解剖标测证实为右后间隔旁路，射频消融成功。
  • Arrhythmias detected by implanted cardiac rhythm recorders in transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis.
    Rev Esp Cardiol (Engl Ed) · 2026-10-23
    在ATTR-CM患者中，植入式循环记录仪监测发现33%需起搏器植入的高度传导障碍和71%无既往房颤者新发房颤，但未改善生存或临床硬终点。
  • Acute Changes in Left Atrial Appendage Flow Velocity During Pulsed Field Ablation: An Intraprocedural Intracardiac Echocardiography Study
    medRxiv · 2026-10-23
    PFA术后左心耳排空与充盈速度急性升高，但约12%患者出现排空速度显著下降。

室性心律失常（12）

  • Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia unmasked by beta-blockade in pheochromocytoma presenting as hypertensive optic neuropathy: a case report and literature review
    Front Med (Lausanne) · 2026-10-24
  • When Swallowing Triggers VT.
    Am J Cardiol · 2026-10-23
    一例年轻健康男性吞咽诱发室速，药物难治，经心脏十字交叉处神经节消融成功。
  • Evaluation and management of clinically significant arrhythmias in the early neonatal period: a single-center retrospective study of NICU-admitted neonates
    BMC Pediatrics · 2026-10-23
    在NICU收治的4126例早期新生儿中，临床显著心律失常发生率为0.97%，以室上性心动过速（尤其是房室折返性心动过速）最常见，经治疗总体预后良好，随访期死亡率低。
  • Cardio-respiratory-gated proton pencil beam scanning for cardiac ablation: workflow and end-to-end validation
    Frontiers in Oncology · 2026-10-23
    在六只健康猪中验证了心肺双门控质子束扫描消融工作流，双门控将内靶区因心脏运动的外扩平均减少45%（19% vs 64%），系统门控响应<550微秒。
  • Distal-to-Proximal Conduction System Ablation as a Bailout Strategy in Refractory Multi-Exit Purkinje-Related Premature Ventricular Contractions and Ventricular Fibrillation.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    对22例难治性多出口浦肯野相关室早患者行远端至近端传导系统消融，急性成功率95.5%，随访32.3个月室早复发仅4.5%，无室颤复发。
  • Mitral Valve Prolapse and Ventricular Arrhythmia Risk in TTN-Mediated Cardiomyopathy: A Single Center Experience.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
  • Prognostic Impact of Ventricular Arrhythmia Timing in Acute Coronary Syndromes Treated with Percutaneous Coronary Intervention: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在ACS接受PCI的患者中，围术期室性心律失常显著增加短期和长期死亡风险，且PCI后发生的VA短期死亡风险最高。
  • Pacemaker-associated bigeminy.
    J Electrocardiol · 2026-10-23
    起搏器相关二联律可由六种特定算法-节律相互作用机制引起，识别这些模式有助于区分正常设备功能与故障。
  • Profound sinus bradycardia preceding ventricular tachycardia storm during emergence from anesthesia in a patient with a prior inferior myocardial infarction: a case report
    JA Clinical Reports · 2026-10-23
    一例既往下壁心梗的血透患者在全麻苏醒期出现严重窦性心动过缓，阿托品处理后心率恢复但节律异常持续，随后发生室速风暴，提示心动过缓治疗后持续节律异常需重新评估。
  • High-Grade Atrioventricular Block and Recurrent Cardiac Arrest in Suspected Isolated Cardiac Sarcoidosis.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-23
    18岁女性反复晕厥，出现高级别房室传导阻滞及反复缓慢型心脏骤停，影像提示疑似孤立性心脏结节病，激素治疗后植入CRT-D。
  • Cardiac screening in the young for the detection of cardiovascular disease and prevention of sudden cardiac death.
    PLoS Med · 2026-10-23
    本文为综述，指出年轻人猝死多源于静默性遗传性心脏病，AI辅助的结构化筛查框架有望提升疾病检出与风险预测，但全球政策框架尚不统一。
  • Prolonged QT Interval in Hospitalized Internal Medicine Patients: A Retrospective Cohort Study of Determinants and Reversibility.
    Rom J Intern Med · 2026-10-23
    在277例住院内科患者中，Bazett公式较Framingham公式显著高估QT间期延长，仅28.1%经QTcF确认；QT延长多为获得性且可逆。

器械治疗（10）

  • Prognostic value of the inflammatory burden index in predicting 1-year mortality in patients undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy for heart failure
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-24
  • Beyond the light-driven pacemaker: the suprachiasmatic nucleus as a dynamic coordinator of environmental cues
    Front Neurosci · 2026-10-24
  • Transvenous Lead Extraction Without Dedicated Surgical Back up in Low-Risk Patients.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在482例低风险经静脉导线拔除患者中，无外科待命团队支持下主要并发症发生率仅0.83%，无患者需外科抢救。
  • Ten-year Performance of the Multi-Layer Insulated Defibrillation Lead in the Medicare Population.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在26830例Medicare患者中，Optisure ICD导线10年无机械并发症生存率为97.2%（最佳情景）至95.6%（最差情景），表现良好。
  • [Psychotherapeutic interventions for reducing stress in patients with cardiac arrhythmias].
    Herzschrittmacherther Elektrophysiol · 2026-10-23
    综述指出，对心律失常患者（尤其ICD术后）进行心理教育及基础心身干预，可打破焦虑-症状恶性循环，减少创伤后应激，但需建立心理-心脏团队。
  • Conduction System Pacing Versus Biventricular Pacing for Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-23
    8项RCT共799例CRT患者中，CSP与BVP在ΔLVEF上无显著差异（+2.40%，P=0.091），但仅纳入LBBB患者的研究提示CSP可能更优。
  • Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy Using a Conduction System Pacing Defibrillation Lead in Patients Meeting CRT-D Indications: Six-Month Clinical Outcomes Results From the ASCEND CSP Study.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-23
    在52例符合CRT-D适应证的患者中，使用专用CSP ICD导线行LOT-CRT植入成功率达98.1%，除颤有效，6个月LVEF改善和CRT反应优于匹配的传统BiV-CRT。
  • Evaluation of Acute Electrical and Hemodynamic Improvement During Left Bundle‐Branch Area Pacing Modalities for Resynchronization Therapy
    Journal of the American Heart Association · 2026-10-23
    在24例心衰合并LBBB患者中，选择性左束支起搏提供最大急性血流动力学获益（ΔSBP 16.3 mmHg），且血流动力学最优AV间期比QRS最窄AV间期短18-29 ms。
  • Circadian rhythms in health and disease.
    Mol Biomed · 2026-10-23
    该综述系统阐述昼夜节律通过BMAL1、CLOCK等核心时钟基因调控代谢、免疫与神经活动，其紊乱与神经退行性疾病、代谢病、肿瘤及心血管病发生进展相关，并提出时间治疗与个体化医疗的转化路径。
  • [Atypical Course of Pacemaker Leads via the Accessory Hemiazygos Vein on Chest Radiography in a Patient with a Hypoplastic Left Brachiocephalic Vein].
    Rofo · 2026-10-23

心力衰竭与代谢（4）

  • Clinically Motivated Redesign of the Pennsylvania State University Child Ventricular Assist Device.
    ASAIO J · 2026-10-23
    PSU儿童心室辅助装置转子经计算优化为五叶片设计，在模拟循环回路中液压性能提升约40%，溶血指数低，为儿科心衰提供更高效可植入装置。
  • Wearable Heart Rate Monitoring in Resource-Limited Healthcare
    Advances in computational intelligence and robotics book series · 2026-10-23
    该综述指出，基于光电容积脉搏波的可穿戴设备结合TinyML可在无网络连接下实现实时心律失常检测，为资源有限地区提供低成本连续心脏监测路径。
  • A study protocol of fasting to provide energy needed to help adults in need of cognitive enhancement (Fasting ENHANCE).
    Exp Gerontol · 2026-10-23
    Fasting ENHANCE 研究方案拟在超重伴主观认知下降的老年人中，以评估者盲法随机对照设计检验 6 个月 8 小时限时进食能否改善认知功能。
  • Interventricular septal LGE predicts response trajectories and clinical prognosis in heart failure patients undergoing left bundle branch area pacing.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    在非缺血性心肌病合并完全性左束支传导阻滞患者中，室间隔纤维化程度可独立预测左束支区域起搏的应答轨迹与预后，室间隔LGE%每升高1%，不良应答进展风险增加14%。

遗传与基础（9）

  • Polycystin dysfunction and cardiac electrical abnormalities in ADPKD.
    Am J Nephrol · 2026-10-23
    ADPKD中多囊蛋白功能异常通过钙稳态失衡等机制导致心脏电重构，表现为QT/QTc延长、房颤和室性心律失常，需加强心肾联合管理。
  • Arrhythmic Risk Stratification in Non-Ischaemic Cardiomyopathy: The Role of Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
    Curr Cardiol Rep · 2026-10-23
    在非缺血性心肌病中，LGE-CMR 检测的替代性纤维化是室性心律失常和心源性猝死的强独立预测因子，其缺失可识别低危人群，CMR 已成为心律失常风险分层基石。
  • Design, Synthesis, and Biological Evaluation of Novel Biphenyl Derivatives with Therapeutic Potential for Atrial Fibrillation by Synergistically Inhibiting NaV1.5 Late Na+ Current and K+ Current.
    J Med Chem · 2026-10-23
    新型联苯衍生物8b通过协同抑制晚钠电流和IKr，在兔AF模型中显示抗心律失常疗效，且避免传导阻滞和QT延长，对多柔比星心衰小鼠有效。
  • Electrophysiological remodeling in the hypertrophic cardiomyopathy MYBPC3 R943X mutant in human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes and modulation by IKto-targeting drugs.
    J Mol Cell Cardiol · 2026-10-23
    携带MYBPC3 R943X突变的hiPSC-CMs表现出显著的电生理重构和致心律失常特征，Kv4通道调节剂NS-5806可部分恢复其正常动作电位形态。
  • Congenital Long QT Syndrome Type 2: Delayed Diagnosis After a Decade of Seizure-Like Episodes.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-23
    93岁男性因反复惊厥样晕厥就诊，基因检测确诊先天性长QT综合征2型，提示高龄患者持续QT延长需考虑遗传性病因。
  • Clinical integration of artificial intelligence for diagnosis, risk prediction and management of rare cardiovascular diseases
    Journal of Basic and Clinical Physiology and Pharmacology · 2026-10-23
    人工智能可提升罕见心血管病的诊断准确性、风险分层和个体化治疗决策，但临床落地仍需标准化多中心数据、前瞻性验证和可解释算法。
  • Sex Differences in the Associations of Age‐Related Genetic Predisposition With Incident Atrial Fibrillation: A Prospective Cohort Study
    Journal of the American Heart Association · 2026-10-23
    在UK Biobank前瞻性队列中，AF多基因风险评分的年龄相关轨迹存在性别差异：40-49岁男性关联更强，60-69岁女性关联更强。
  • Research trends and hotspot analysis of sudden cardiac death in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
    Medicine · 2026-10-23
    文献计量分析显示，肥厚型心肌病相关心脏性猝死研究呈指南驱动式增长，热点已从机制研究转向多模态风险预测、AI模型与靶向药物治疗。
  • Arrhythmic events and genetic variants as drivers for Takotsubo Syndrome: a patient-specific atrial stem-cell model.
    Signal Transduct Target Ther · 2026-10-23
    TTS患者来源的心房iPSC-CM在异丙肾上腺素刺激下出现SR钙漏和致心律失常表型，PDE4激活剂MR-L2可逆转异常并预防心律失常，优于β受体阻滞剂。

其他（9）

  • It's about time: modeling circadian regulation of cardiac electrophysiology and arrhythmogenesis.
    Am J Physiol Cell Physiol · 2026-10-23
    本综述提出将昼夜节律调控整合到心脏电生理计算模型中，以更准确模拟心律失常易感性和药物反应的时间依赖性。
  • Procedural Success, Predictors of Failure, and Clinical Outcomes of Conduction System Pacing in Korea: The Korean Conduction System Pacing (K-CSP) Registry.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
    韩国多中心注册研究显示，传导系统起搏成功率达87.4%，直接夺获传导系统（LBBP+LFP）较LVSP与更低的心衰住院调整风险相关（HR 3.04），但事件数少，需随机试验验证。
  • Undiagnosed Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy Hidden in Explanted Hearts: Insights from a Single Tertiary Center.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
  • A Technique for Slack Formation During Proximal Left Bundle Branch Pacing With a Lumenless Defibrillation Lead.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-23
  • Developing an Institutional Paediatric EP Practice in Hong Kong: our reflections.
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-23
  • Immunohistochemical markers for dating cardiac conduction system injury: current knowledge and forensic implications.
    Int J Legal Med · 2026-10-23
    综述指出，用于心室肌损伤时间推断的免疫组化标志物不能直接套用于心脏传导系统，需专门验证。
  • Embolic Myocardial Infarction From Delayed Left Bundle Lead Perforation.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-23
  • A lightweight progressive residual convolutional network for interpretable arrhythmia classification.
    Phys Eng Sci Med · 2026-10-23
    提出轻量级渐进残差卷积注意力网络DResCA，在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库五分类任务中达到98.35%准确率和97.99%宏F1，参数量少于主流深度学习模型。
  • Ballistic Drift and Wavefront Breakup of Scroll Waves Induced by Ordered Discrete Bagua Heterogeneity
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-23
    在Barkley反应扩散模型中，有序离散的八卦构型异质性场可诱导螺旋波从刚性旋转转为方向锁定的弹道漂移，并最终导致波前破碎和缺陷介导的湍流，其机制不同于随机噪声或单一障碍物。

item.title: 2026-10-23 心脏电生理日报（21 篇）
item.description:
共 21 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（10）

  • Predictive Value of the HALP Score for Post-Operative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft Surgery
    Angiology · 2026-10-22
    在448例CABG患者中，HALP评分对术后房颤的预测能力优于其他4项营养-炎症指标（AUC 0.812），将其纳入LASSO基础模型后联合模型AUC达0.897，内部验证校正AUC 0.885。
  • Intraoperative New-onset Atrial Fibrillation during Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography: A Peri-anesthetic Challenge.
    Ann Afr Med · 2026-10-22
  • Recurrence analysis of cardiac arrhythmias: A systematic review of methods, substrate characterisation and clinical translation
    Computers in Biology and Medicine · 2026-10-22
    系统综述49项研究显示，复发量化分析可揭示颤动信号的非随机结构，但方法学异质性大、阈值选择缺乏标准，仅1项前瞻性研究用于消融指导，临床转化尚未成熟。
  • Managing Atrial Fibrillation in the Athlete: Practical Insights Beyond the Guidelines
    Current Treatment Options in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-22
  • Source-Specific PM2.5 Exposure and Atrial Fibrillation Risk in U.S. Older Adults: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
    Environ Health (Wash) · 2026-10-22
    在美国老年人群中，长期暴露于交通、重油/煤燃烧、二次硫酸盐和二次硝酸盐来源的PM2.5与房颤风险增加相关，且存在地域异质性。
  • Nationwide assessment of early hospitalizations and mortality after pulsed field ablation.
    Europace · 2026-10-22
  • Left atrial appendage morphology and hemodynamics: potential new markers for individualized thromboembolic risk assessment in atrial fibrillation.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-22
    左心耳形态分型与血栓风险相关但受临床情境影响，传统分型与血液淤滞不直接相关，定量几何参数和数字孪生技术可更精准识别高风险患者。
  • Frequent Premature Ventricular Complexes and Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-22
    房颤消融患者中频发室早（≥1%）基线患病率18.4%，消融后179天内新发9.0%、逆转10.9%，但2年随访≥1%室早比例显著增加，基线室早负荷和高血压是唯一预测因素。
  • Decoding Atrial Fibrillation Heterogeneity
    JACC Advances · 2026-10-22
  • Aveir VR for Atrial Leadless Pacing in Young Patients
    Pediatric Cardiology · 2026-10-22
    在5例14-17岁男性窦房结功能障碍患者中，经股静脉将Aveir VR无导线起搏器植入心房，随访1-23个月起搏参数稳定，无并发症报告。

室性心律失常（5）

  • Unexpected Death in a Preschool Child
    American Journal of Forensic Medicine & Pathology · 2026-10-22
    一例4岁儿童因左心室肥厚基础上发生心肌炎导致意外死亡，提示临床需高度警惕心肌炎并规范尸检流程。
  • Antenatally detected right ventricular outflow tract aneurysm with neonatal ventricular arrhythmia.
    Cardiol Young · 2026-10-22
    一例产前超声偶然发现的胎儿右室流出道巨大室壁瘤，新生儿期出现右室流出道起源频发室早，早期胺碘酮治疗后心律失常迅速消失。
  • Validity of Administrative ICD-10 Diagnosis Codes for Ventricular Arrhythmia and Cardiac Arrest in a French University Hospital.
    Clin Epidemiol · 2026-10-22
    在法国亚眠大学医院182例患者中，ICD-10编码识别室性心律失常和心脏骤停的阳性预测值均较高（0.93-0.99），支持用于药物流行病学研究。
  • Unexpected Non-immune Hydrops Foetalis With Supraventricular Tachycardia in a Premature Neonate
    Cureus · 2026-10-22
  • Prolonged QT Interval in Hospitalized Internal Medicine Patients: A Retrospective Cohort Study of Determinants and Reversibility
    Romanian Journal of Internal Medicine · 2026-10-22
    在277例住院内科患者中，Bazett公式较Framingham公式显著且心率依赖性高估QT间期延长，仅28.1%患者经QTcF确认延长，QT延长多为获得性且可逆。

遗传与基础（3）

  • Post-hospitalisation COVID-19 study: a national consortium to understand and improve long-term health outcomes (PHOSP-COVID) - COV0319
    2026-10-22
    PHOSP-COVID 研究纳入 7935 例 COVID-19 住院后出院者，5 个月时仅约 30% 完全康复，1 年时改善有限，女性、35-65 岁、肥胖、多病共存或机械通气者恢复更差。
  • Risk stratification in early non-ischaemic cardiomyopathy: the interplay of genetics and cardiac imaging.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-22
    综述指出，早期非缺血性心肌病仅凭LVEF进行危险分层不足，整合CMR-LGE纤维化负荷与基因型特异性表型可推动更个性化的猝死预防策略。
  • Hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis in peripheral neuropathy: prevalence, clinical features, and neurology-based screening in non-endemic Japan
    Frontiers in Neurology · 2026-10-22
    在日本非流行区神经内科疑似周围神经病患者中，ATTRv患病率为2.31%，3例均无家族史且伴心脏受累，心电图低电压可能提示隐匿性心脏淀粉样变。

其他（3）

  • First-tier copy-number variant analysis in inherited cardiomyopathy: reconsidering the case for second-tier triage.
    Europace · 2026-10-22
  • Immunohistochemical markers for dating cardiac conduction system injury: current knowledge and forensic implications
    International Journal of Legal Medicine · 2026-10-22
    综述指出，用于心室肌损伤时间推断的免疫组化标志物（如C5b-9、肌钙蛋白、纤连蛋白、连接蛋白43）不能直接套用于心脏传导系统，亟需组织特异性验证研究。
  • Disseminated Lymphoplasmacytic Lymphoma to the Sympathetic Chain Causing VT Storm.
    JACC CardioOncol · 2026-10-22

item.title: 2026-10-22 心脏电生理日报（9 篇）
item.description:
共 9 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（5）

  • Epidemiology, comorbidity profiles, and oral anticoagulation patterns among patients with atrial fibrillation in Turkey: a meta-analysis of national registry-based and multicenter observational studies.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-10-21
    土耳其6项注册研究共18,219例AF患者的荟萃分析显示，NOAC使用率在全体入组注册中约60%、总体OAC约88%，但消融（3%）与复律（9%）等节律控制措施使用率低。
  • Association between insulin resistance-related indices and the risk of recurrence after catheter ablation in patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation.
    Cardiovasc Diabetol · 2026-10-21
    在非瓣膜性房颤首次消融患者中，eGDR、CTI、TyG-BMI和METS-IR与术后1年复发风险独立相关，其中eGDR预测性能最佳。
  • Source-Specific PM2.5 Exposure and Atrial Fibrillation Risk in U.S. Older Adults: A Nationwide Cohort Study
    Environment & Health · 2026-10-21
  • Nationwide assessment of early hospitalizations and mortality after pulsed field ablation
    Europace · 2026-10-21
  • Left atrial appendage morphology and hemodynamics: potential new markers for individualized thromboembolic risk assessment in atrial fibrillation
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-21

室性心律失常（1）

  • Sudden cardiac arrest during diagnostic workup: a rare case of high-risk interarterial left anterior descending artery anomaly.
    J Cardiothorac Surg · 2026-10-21
    65岁女性因心绞痛行负荷试验后，在冠脉CTA检查中发生室颤导致心脏骤停，确诊为左前降支动脉间走行高危异常，行搭桥手术并结扎近端分支后恢复良好。

器械治疗（1）

  • Cardiac MRI at 3.0T in the presence of implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs)
    medRxiv · 2026-10-21
    在3.0T临床磁共振上，采用宽频带PSIR LGE和扰相GRE CINE序列，可对植入ICD的患者完成心脏磁共振成像，多数扫描伪影得到充分抑制。

遗传与基础（1）

  • Integrated proteomics and machine learning reveal AHNAK as a discriminative biomarker of atrial fibrillation in heart failure.
    BMC Med · 2026-10-21
    在急性失代偿性心衰患者中，血浆AHNAK蛋白可有效区分房颤（AUC=0.897），其表达降低与心房纤维化及房颤风险增加相关。

其他（1）

  • First-tier copy-number variant analysis in inherited cardiomyopathy: reconsidering the case for second-tier triage
    Europace · 2026-10-21

item.title: 2026-10-21 心脏电生理日报（24 篇）
item.description:
共 24 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（12）

  • A Conservatively Managed Giant Ascending Aortic Aneurysm Presenting With New Atrial Fibrillation and Heart Failure.
    Cureus · 2026-10-20
    88岁女性新发房颤伴心衰，超声意外发现9.3 cm升主动脉瘤，因高龄衰弱未手术，保守治疗并抗凝，2个月随访瘤体未增大。
  • Maintenance of atrial fibrillation by reciprocal triggering of competitive focal sources: a hypothesis.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-20
    该假说提出，房颤的维持可能源于多个竞争性局灶源（由延迟后除极相互触发）的周期性主导切换，而非完整折返，这解释了Cox迷宫术和肺静脉隔离的成功机制。
  • Case Report: Angiography-guided transvenous single-chamber pacemaker implantation in mirror-image dextrocardia with congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-20
    本例为镜像右位心合并先天性矫正型大动脉转位患者，经右腋静脉造影引导植入单腔起搏器，手术成功且随访1年稳定。
  • Single versus double transseptal puncture for atrial fibrillation radiofrequency ablation: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-20
    单次房间隔穿刺与双次穿刺在房颤射频消融中3个月窦性心律维持率、透视时间和并发症发生率相当，但单次穿刺手术时间显著延长。
  • Efficacy, safety, and strategy-modifying factors of pulsed field ablation for persistent and long-standing persistent atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-20
    在持续性及长程持续性房颤中，脉冲场消融总体有效且安全，12个月无房性心律失常复发率约66%-83%，对比冷冻球囊复发风险更低（RR 0.71），但证据确定性低至极低。
  • Physiologic Stress During Walking and Cycling Early After Cardiac Surgery.
    J Cardiopulm Rehabil Prev · 2026-10-20
    心脏术后早期，6分钟步行试验中的心脏做功（总心搏数/步行距离）可行，且与踏车试验的心率反应相似；女性与更高心脏做功独立相关，房颤与较低心率相关，衰弱程度高则步行距离更短。
  • Long-Term Association Between Comprehensive Cardiac Rehabilitation and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Rhythm-Control Interventions.
    J Cardiopulm Rehabil Prev · 2026-10-20
  • Pulsed Field Ablation for Cardiac Arrhythmias: Industry Landscape and US Food and Drug Administration-approved Platforms (2025).
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    综述指出PFA已从实验技术成为房颤一线消融疗法，FDA批准的多种平台正推动其向局灶和混合消融策略演进。
  • Evaluation and Classification of Atrial Arrhythmias from Signatures in Electrographic Flow Metrics.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    在151例房颤消融患者中，电解剖血流标测的失组织化评分和平均血流一致性可区分房颤、微折返房扑与局灶房速，多层感知器模型鉴别准确率达81%。
  • Impact of Frailty on Recurrence After Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    在房颤导管消融患者中，衰弱使房性快速性心律失常复发风险增加57%（RR 1.57，95%CI 1.26-1.94），应纳入术前风险分层。
  • Atrial fibrillation in stroke patients: facts, numbers and current challenges.
    Neurol Res Pract · 2026-10-20
    房颤是缺血性卒中可干预的重要危险因素，20-30%卒中患者存在房颤；不同临床情境下抗凝策略需个体化，新治疗手段尚需随机对照试验验证。
  • Spanish catheter ablation registry. 25th official report of the Heart Rhythm Association of the Spanish Society of Cardiology (2025).
    Rev Esp Cardiol (Engl Ed) · 2026-10-20
    2025年西班牙导管消融注册研究显示，共109个中心完成33,435例消融，房颤仍是最常见心律失常（14,452例），脉冲场消融使用率显著增至37%，总体急性成功率95%、并发症率1.6%、死亡率0.04%。

室性心律失常（3）

  • Late gadolinium enhancement dispersion mapping predicts major arrhythmic events in patients with prior myocardial infarction.
    Int J Cardiol · 2026-10-20
    在364例陈旧性心梗患者中，基于心脏磁共振晚期钆增强（LGE）图像计算的全局离散度评分（GDS）可独立预测恶性室性心律失常事件，尤其在LVEF>35%的患者中，其预测价值优于LGE范围和LVEF。
  • Postextrastimulus Termination of Ventricular Tachycardia: An Indicator of a Good Ablation Site?
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    本病例报告提示，心动过速时给予单个期外刺激可终止室速，可能提示消融靶点良好，但需仔细分析拖带反应以区分机制。
  • Electromechanical Window Negativity and Arrhythmic Risk in Arrhythmogenic Mitral Valve Prolapse.
    JACC Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-10-20
    在致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂患者中，机电窗口（EMW）显著负向，且与持续性室性心律失常独立相关，可作为风险标志物。

器械治疗（2）

  • Failure of Implantable Cardioverter-defibrillator Pacing Capture in BRASH Syndrome with Severe Hyperkalemia.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-20
    一例54岁终末期肾病合并心衰女性，因高钾血症（7.8 mEq/L）导致ICD起搏夺获失败，经降钾治疗和透析后恢复。
  • Subcutaneous versus transvenous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapy: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Open Heart · 2026-10-20

心力衰竭与代谢（1）

  • Clinical spectrum and risk factors for severe arrhythmias in non-surgical pediatric patients: a single-center retrospective study.
    J Cardiothorac Surg · 2026-10-20
    单中心428例儿童心律失常回顾性研究显示，婴幼儿年龄、基础心脏病、晕厥史和心功能III-IV级是严重心律失常的独立危险因素，预测模型AUC达0.925。

遗传与基础（5）

  • Multimodal KCNQ1 Variant-Effect Maps Define Ion Channel Mechanisms and Disease Risk.
    Circulation · 2026-10-20
    研究对KCNQ1基因的13403个变异进行高通量功能评估，发现1757个变异有强致病证据，功能丧失变异与QT延长及长QT综合征显著相关，且多数致病变异通过显性负性效应增加心律失常风险。
  • Short- and long-term effects of dronedarone on Cav3.1- and Cav3.2-T-type calcium channel current.
    Eur J Histochem · 2026-10-20
    决奈达隆抑制T型钙通道，对Cav3.2亚型抑制作用更强（IC50 9.20 µM），慢性处理减慢通道动力学，并在心肌梗死模型中加重心肌损伤和纤维化。
  • Atrial Fibrillation in Valvular Heart Disease: Assessing the Impact of Genetics in the UK Biobank.
    JACC Adv · 2026-10-20
    在UK Biobank中，AF多基因风险评分可预测二尖瓣疾病患者的AF风险（尤其MVP），但对主动脉瓣疾病无显著预测价值，提示遗传贡献因VHD亚型而异。
  • Long-Term Outcome Following Idiopathic Ventricular Fibrillation and Potential Emerging Etiologies.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-20
    特发性室颤幸存者长期随访显示心脏死亡率低（1.2%），但心律失常复发率高达52.7%，且68.8%的患者在随访中明确或可能明确新病因，提示需持续监测与个体化管理。
  • Convergent Ferroptosis and Pyroptosis in MASLD-Associated Cardiac Remodeling.
    Transl Res · 2026-10-20
    本综述提出铁死亡与细胞焦亡可能是连接MASLD与心脏重构的共同调节性细胞死亡通路，但跨器官肝-心轴尚未在MASLD模型或患者中直接验证。

其他（1）

  • A Puzzling Supraventricular Rhythm: A Diagnostic and Therapeutic Challenge.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-20

item.title: 2026-10-19 心脏电生理日报（38 篇）
item.description:
共 38 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（22）

  • In-Hospital Mortality After Aortic Valve Replacement Surgical Versus Transcatheter: A Nationwide Study with Machine Learning-Based Risk Prediction.
    Am J Cardiol · 2026-10-19
    基于美国全国再入院数据库的361,875例主动脉瓣置换患者分析显示，SAVR较TAVR院内死亡风险显著更高（OR 2.66，95%CI 2.51-2.81），但30天至6个月随访死亡率无差异。
  • Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation in adult patients admitted to an intensive care unit.
    Ann Intensive Care · 2026-10-19
    法国重症医学会基于GRADE方法制定成人ICU内房颤管理专家建议，共18条推荐，其中16条仅为专家意见，仅2条基于低级别证据。
  • Development and external validation of a 2-year mortality risk model for atrial fibrillation and heart failure with an online calculator
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-19
    本研究开发并外部验证了房颤合并心衰患者2年死亡风险预测模型，包含9个预测因子，区分度良好（AUC 0.848和0.862），并提供了在线计算器。
  • Prospective multicenter feasibility study of omnipolar near-field peak-frequency mapping for slow-pathway localization in typical atrioventricular nodal re-entrant tachycardia
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-19
    在典型AVNRT患者中，基于OTNF的峰值频率标测可识别慢径消融靶区，90%有效消融点对应最高PF区，平均PF 424 Hz vs 周围272 Hz。
  • Echocardiography-derived Left Atrial Volumetric-Mechanical Coupling Index predicts early new-onset atrial fibrillation after embolic stroke/transient ischemic attack of undetermined source.
    Clin Res Cardiol · 2026-10-19
    在ESUS/TIA患者中，超声心动图衍生的LACI-VM可独立预测新发房颤，联合左室充盈压可识别极低危（约2%）与高危（约20%）亚组。
